strings.(모험가의 손이 닿은 신석이 여러 조각으로 갈라져 바닥에 흩어진다. 깜짝: (The divine stone beneath the adventurer's hand splits into fragments and scatters across the floor. Startled, Medea quickly catches the staggering adventurer.)
That doesn't sound like a fun message...
%s, endure the heat. We're only checking the oracle's contents.
strings.(리디아가 어깨 위에 있는 정령 로로를 들어 %s의 머리 위에 올려놓는다: (Lydia lifts Roro from her shoulder and places the spirit on %s's head.)
Really? Askren screamed that he felt like he was being pickled in lava.
How embarrassing. I was only ninth rank then. I simply had no resistance.
strings.원한다면 다시 로로를 얹어 줄까?: Want me to put Roro on you again?
strings.그런데 언제까지 이 정령을 머리 위에 두고 있어야 해요?: How long do I have to keep this spirit on my head?
strings.(리디아가 정령 로로를 붙잡아 다시 어깨 위에 올리자, 로로가 리디아의: (Lydia picks Roro up and returns the spirit to her shoulder. Roro whispers something in her ear.)
strings.마신의 운명을 지닌 자가 아마란스 노바에서 기다리고 있으니, 그자의 심장: The one bearing the fate of a Demon God waits in Amaranth Nova. Pierce his heart and destroy him...
strings.알고 있어요. 신탁의 내용이 이뤄지는 순간까지 이리스의 목소리를 들을 수: I know. I won't hear Iris's voice until the oracle is fulfilled.
I know you have more to say. Go ahead. It's all right.
If I defeat him, I'll become a Deicide, someone who killed a god...
That depends on Barbatos's condition and your own will.
strings.운에 의지해야 한다는 뜻인가요?: Does that mean I have to trust in luck?
strings.너무 걱정할 필요는 없어. 최악의 상황을 피하기 위해 우리는 우리대로 움: Don't worry too much. We'll help in our own way to avoid the worst outcome.
Generally, an oracle forbids direct intervention by others.
strings.보통 사람들이 신탁에 개입하면 신의 분노가 담긴 벌을 받게 돼. 그러나: Ordinary people who interfere face a punishment bearing the god's wrath. But Demigods carry out divine work, so we have some latitude.
We still can't do your part for you.
Oh, Shynic and Medea. Just to be clear...
strings.무슨 말을 할지 대충 알아. 신탁을 내린 초보 여신님이 허락하지 않은 상: I know what you're going to say. Our novice goddess hasn't given permission, so we're not to interfere.
This concerns Barbatos alone. It can't be helped.
If it's the goddess's will, there's no choice...
We'll go now. Come, Father Askren. We have much to do.
strings.대륙을 건너 여기까지 왔는데 벌써 가자고요? 식사 한 끼 정도는 하고 갈: We crossed the continent to get here, and we're leaving already? Surely we can have one meal.
strings.…아스크렌 사제는 말이 많아도 너무 많아. 나 화낸다? 여기 로로도 있다: ...Father Askren, you talk far too much. Do you want me angry? Roro is right here.
It was a pleasure meeting you all. Until next time, %s.
Please give us some notice before your next visit.
I don't know if it'll be possible, but I'll try. Farewell...
strings.(리디아와 아스크렌이 모두에게 인사를 하고 마을을 빠져나간다.): (Lydia and Askren say goodbye to everyone and leave the village.)
Oh, right. I meant to ask where Amaranth Nova is...
My head is suddenly so full. I'll take a short walk in Adrika.
I'll come. Medea, I'm heading back now.
strings.응. 이번에는 즐거웠어. 다음에도 할 일 생기면 같이 하자. 또 혼자 하: Okay. This was fun. Let's work together again next time. Don't do everything alone. All right?
strings.그럼 진짜 갈게. 어, %s? 어디 갔어? 같이 가자니까!!: Then I'm really going. Huh, %s? Where did you go? I said we'd go together!
(Minuet encounters the adventurer out for a walk and steps back in mild surprise.)
strings.어라, 미뉴에트. 왜 여기 있어? 여행 간 거 아냐?: Oh, Minuet. Why are you here? Weren't you traveling?
strings.원래 다른 곳으로 가려고 했는데, 어떻게 하다 보니 다시 아드리카로 왔어: I meant to go elsewhere, but somehow returned to Adrika... I felt I needed to come back...
Our novice goddess gave %s an oracle.
strings.이 일로 머릿속이 복잡해져서…. 이리스와 이야기를 하고 싶은데, 신탁이: It's left my thoughts in a tangle... I want to talk to Iris, but apparently we can't communicate once an oracle has been issued...
Whatever it says, Iris would never want a bad outcome...
At the very least, it must be a choice made for this world.
You're right. I was overcomplicating things...
strings.다시 바보 같은 표정으로 돌아온 걸 보니 이제 괜찮은 거지?: You've got your usual silly expression back. Feeling better?
strings.나도 도와주고 싶지만 안 된다고 하니까 이렇게밖에 못 하네. 나중에 재미: I want to help, too, but I'm told I can't. This is all I can do. I'll enjoy hearing your story later, so do your best.
strings.맞다, 미뉴에트. 너 타르타로스에서 살지 않을래? 전보다는 재미있을 거야: Oh, Minuet. Want to live in Tartaros? It'll be more fun than before ♡
strings.고맙습니다, 샤이닉 님. 지금은 말고, 조금만 더 돌아다니고서 찾아뵐게요: Thank you, Shynic. Not just yet. I'll travel a little more, then visit...
What a shame. I was going to arrange all sorts of fun if you came.
strings.아, 재미없어. 타르타로스로 가야지. %s, 넌 다시 칼리로 가. 메디아: Oh, boring. I'll go to Tartaros. %s, go back to Kali. Medea will worry.
Goodbye, everyone ♡ Stay alive until we meet again.
strings.(샤이닉이 인사를 마치고는 그대로 타르타로스 뱡향으로 뛰어간다.): (Shynic finishes her farewell and runs toward Tartaros.)
I was going to say goodbye, but I was too late...
You're too slow, Minuet. Well, I'll return to Kali now.
strings.저는 다시 발길 닿는 대로 가 보려고요…. 어디로 갈지는 모르지만, 항상: I'll go wherever my feet take me again... I don't know where, but I'll be careful.
strings.(미뉴에트가 이상한 낌새를 느끼고는 서둘러 자리를 벗어나려 뛰어간다. 그: (Sensing something strange, Minuet hurriedly runs away. A small black butterfly flies over and lands on her shoulder.)
This butterfly... Could it be... Ugh... Was it you who called me...?
strings.(미뉴에트가 나비를 알아보고서 순간 몸에 힘이 풀려 그대로 주저앉는다.): (Recognizing the butterfly, Minuet suddenly loses her strength and collapses.)
strings.(미뉴에트의 어깨에 앉아 있던 나비가 날아가 다가오는 존재의 손 끝에 앉: (The butterfly leaves Minuet's shoulder and lands on the fingertip of an approaching figure.)
strings.가이아의 현신답게 나와 이 나비를 알아보는군요. 가이아를 따라 움직이던: As Gaia's incarnation, you recognize this butterfly and me. It once followed Gaia. After she fell asleep, it must have sought a god, appearing before me while I had no memories.
I made good use of it. You have my thanks for that.
strings.겁에 질린 모습도 나쁘지 않네요. 이게 가이아였다면 더 좋았겠지만. 잡담: That frightened look isn't bad, either. Better still if it were Gaia's. But enough small talk...
Much like what I said to them...
strings.(이름이 불린 바르바토스의 표정이 일그러진다. 그러나 이내 침착하게 여유: (Barbatos's expression twists at the name. Then he regains his composure and looks at Minuet calmly.)
For now, I will speak as Barbatos.
strings.당신에게 유감은 없지만, 눈과 귀를 멀게 하겠습니다. 잠들어 있는 가이아: I bear you no grudge, but I will blind your eyes and deafen your ears. So sleeping Gaia remains trapped in nightmares forever, unable to awaken.
strings.표정을 보니 생각이 많이 정리된 것 같군요. 괜찮으시죠?: You look as though you've sorted through your thoughts. Are you all right?
Yes... Maybe talking to Minuet helped.
strings.언제 왔는지 그 자리에 있더라고요. 저와 이야기하고는 홀연히 다시 떠났어: She was there when I arrived. After we talked, she quietly left again.
I hope nothing happens to her.
I should. First, I'll gather information...
Hilda, this is something only I...
Have you forgotten? I'm different. Our souls...
strings.아무도 개입할 수 없다고 했지만 나는 괜찮을 거야. 그리고 조금 떨어져서: They said no one could interfere, but I should be all right. And if I follow at a distance...
I'm following whether you like it or not.
strings.혼자 두고 갈 생각은 하지 마. 나는 나대로 해야 할 일이라고 생각하니까: Don't even think about leaving me alone. I believe this is something I must do, too.
So stubborn... All right. Come with me. Better than going alone.
strings.마지막으로 부탁 하나만 할게. 고통을 덜어 내는 주문을 걸어 줘. 더는: One last favor. Cast the spell that eases my pain. I won't ask like this again...
We need to meet again, after all.
strings.(메디아가 조용히 눈을 감고서 지팡이로 힐다의 어깨를 살며시 두드린다.): (Medea quietly closes her eyes and gently taps Hilda's shoulder with her staff.)
You should be able to hold on for a while... But come back if it gets difficult.
strings.숨는 건 잘하니까 여차하면 %s 버리고 도망칠게. 됐지?: I'm good at hiding. If things go wrong, I'll abandon %s and run. Happy?
strings.편한대로 해. 그건 그렇고 아마란스 노바…가 어디에 있지?: Do what suits you. Now, where is Amaranth Nova...?
strings.10년 전에 가는 길이 차단된 린포드라는 도시가 있어. 천계의 조각 중: There's a city called Linford whose road was blocked ten years ago. It's a fragment of the Celestial Realm, also called the city of angels.
Is it that place? Up the road from the windmill...
Yes. Nearby Devesis was connected to Barbatos long ago.
strings.…천계의 조각이라면 숨을 수 있을 거라고 생각했는데, 들어갈 수도 없었거: ...I thought a fragment of the Celestial Realm might be somewhere I could hide, but I couldn't even get in.
strings.그리고 다프네가 말하길, 대공이 10년 전에 과거의 기억을 떠올리고 모습: And Daphne said the Grand Duke recovered memories of his past and appeared ten years ago.
There seems to be a connection.
strings.거기 지금도 들어갈 수 없어?: Can you still not get in?
strings.마을 사람들 이야기를 듣고 잠깐 앞까지 다녀왔는데, 커다란 마력 결계 같: I heard about it from the villagers and went to look. An enormous magical barrier was spread across the road.
That's the place I suspect, at least. I'll ask people who might know, then find a way in.
strings.오늘은 이미 늦은 것 같은데, 내일 떠나시는 건 어때요?: It's already late. Why not leave tomorrow?
One day's leeway should be fine. Let's do as Medea says.
All right. We'll rest here and leave tomorrow morning.
Thank you. I'll prepare somewhere for you to rest. Please have a peaceful evening.
strings.그리고 미리 인사를 드리겠습니다. 전 내일 아침 일찍 자리를 비울 것 같: I'll say goodbye now, too. I expect to leave early tomorrow.
strings.미스트우드와 관련해서 지스카드 님께 말씀을 드려 보려고요. 혹시 제가 놓: To speak with Ziskad about Mistwood. I may have overlooked something.
I will... Until next time, both of you...
...Medea needs rest, too. She has too much to do.
strings.네가 알지 모르겠지만 데이나 씨라고, 10년 전에 바르바토스를 만난 적이: Someone named Dayna. I don't know if you know her. She met Barbatos ten years ago.
strings.많이는 아니고 조금. 전에 잠깐 마주친 적이 있거든. 그쪽에서는 나를 자: A little. We crossed paths briefly before. She won't know much about me.
Enough talking. Get some rest. We have a long journey starting tomorrow.
strings.눈 뜨면 에스닐로 가도록 해. 알아서 쫓아갈게. 금방 만날 수 있으니까: Go to Esnil when you wake. I'll follow. We'll meet soon, so don't wait around like a child.
Let's travel as safely as possible. Surely Ouroboros won't appear now...
We'll have a chance to discuss that this time.
strings.(힐다가 할 말을 끝내고 뒤돌아 메디아의 집 뒤쪽으로 사라진다.): (Hilda finishes speaking, turns, and disappears behind Medea's house.)
strings.그대는 뭐가 그렇게 두렵지? 무엇을 두려워하기에 날 막는가?: What frightens you so? What do you fear that makes you stand in my way?
If obstructing me is your best choice, I will become your worst moment.
Just as you did, regardless of light or darkness... All of it...
That is how the sin called divinity ends...
strings.(간밤에 무슨 꿈을 꾼 것 같은데….): (I think I dreamed something last night...)
strings.(처음 보는 장소에 서 있는 사람…. 누구지? 누군가를 향해 이야기하고: (Someone standing in an unfamiliar place... Who was it? They seemed to be speaking to someone...)
strings.(……바르바토스였나? 후우, 모르겠다….): (...Was it Barbatos? Whew. I don't know...)
strings.(이러고 있을 시간 없어. 서두르자. 데이나 씨가 자리에 있으면 좋겠는데: (No time for this. Let's hurry. I hope Dayna is there...)
strings.(%s의 이야기가 끝나자 데이나가 감고 있던 눈을 살며시 뜬다.): (When %s finishes speaking, Dayna slowly opens her eyes.)
strings.사랑에 눈먼 악마가 바르바토스의 힘을 가져가기 위해 수천 년을 공들였다니: A demon blinded by love spent thousands of years trying to take Barbatos's power. How interesting. And now he's about to become a god...
strings.신탁이라…. %s 씨가 그런 바르바토스를 막아야 하는데, 다른 사람이 개: An oracle... %s, you have to stop him, but no one else can interfere. That's frustrating...
I'm one of the people who wants to kill Barbatos, too...
strings.비록 수년 동안 그림자 사이에서 부정한 것들을 없애며 강해졌지만, 바르바: I spent years growing stronger, eliminating corruption in the shadows. But when Barbatos appeared before me again, I realized...
He was stronger than ten years ago, and I couldn't stop him...
strings.그래서 %s 씨에게 기대했는지 몰라…. 여신과 함께 그를 쓰러뜨릴 수 있: Perhaps that's why I placed my hopes on you, %s... The only one who could defeat him with the goddess...
strings.후우, 내 감상은 잠시 접어 두자. 질문에 대한 답이 먼저니까. 미안해…: Whew. Enough of my feelings. Your question comes first. Sorry...
strings.아마란스 노바인지는 모르겠지만, 바르바토스가 처음 나타났을 때 어떤 장소: I don't know whether it was Amaranth Nova, but when Barbatos first appeared, he mentioned a place.
strings.시이나를 인질로 붙잡고, 자신이 있던 천계로 들어가 모든 걸 일으켜야 한: He held Shiina hostage, saying he had to enter the Celestial Realm where he'd once been and awaken everything...
He killed my father, then vanished hurriedly as though something had gone wrong...
strings.그럴지도 몰라. 오랫동안 바르바토스를 옆에서 조종해 온 악마라면 충분히…: Perhaps. A demon who manipulated him at his side for so long could certainly...
strings.그런데 시이나에게 무슨 힘이라도 있나요? 다프네도 바르바토스도 그런 식으: Does Shiina have some special power? Daphne and Barbatos both spoke that way.
strings.마법사로서 마력을 다루는 소질이 있는 정도야…. 그 후로 시이나에게 별일: Only an aptitude for wielding magic as a mage... I kept watching to see whether anything happened to her afterward, but nothing major did.
strings.그리고 그 일이 일어난 지 얼마 되지 않아 린포드에 지진이 일어났고, 가: Not long after that incident, I heard there had been an earthquake in Linford and the road was blocked...
strings.혹시 몰라 가 봤지만 강한 마력 결계가 펼쳐져 있어서 당장 할 수 있는: I went to check, but a powerful magical barrier left me unable to do anything.
strings.나중에 조금이나마 힘을 키워서 이것저것 시도해 봤지만 마찬가지였어. 그나: Later, after growing a little stronger, I tried various things. Same result. The one thing I learned...
Was that Linford is under the influence of divine power.
strings.그림자를 넘나드는 우리가 할 수 있는 일은 딱 거기까지였어. 더 알고 싶: That was the limit of what we who cross the shadows could do. There was no one to ask for more.
But that's not true for you, %s.
strings.아…, 맞아요. 천사님들이 있었지. 신을 지키는 전투 천사인데, 대화하려: Oh... Right. The angels. Battle angels who guard gods, though you usually have to fight before they'll talk.
strings.생각해 보니 싸우지 않는 분이 한 분 계시네요. 데이나 씨, 저 바로 가: Actually, there's one who doesn't fight. Dayna, I'll go now.
strings.그런데 왜 이야기 중에 자꾸 뒤를 돌아보는 거야? 뒤에 누가 있어?: Why do you keep looking behind you as we talk? Is someone there?
Sorry. I have a companion. She's very shy, so she's hiding.
strings.언제라도 도울 일이 있으면 이야기해 줘. 아론이 사라졌다고 해서 다 끝난: Tell me whenever I can help. Aaron's disappearance didn't mean everything was over. I was too complacent...
I'll tell you if anything happens. See you later, Dayna.
I'm glad you came to me first among my sisters with your questions.
...It's a little daunting having to fight as soon as we meet.
strings.그렇지? 미카, 라피, 가브는 만나면 싸움부터 시작해서 나도 피곤하다니까: Right? Mika, Rafi, and Gab always start with a fight. Even I find it exhausting. So, what do you want to know?
strings.(우리엘라에게 오게 된 경위를 설명한다.): (I explain to Uriella why I came.)
strings.어느 정도 짐작하긴 했지만, 네 입으로 들으니까 느낌이 다르네. 그 이름: I suspected some of it, but hearing it from you feels different. And it's been so long since I heard that name.
strings.갑자기 사라져서 어디 갔나 했는데, 바르바토스라는 마족으로 살아 있었구나: He suddenly disappeared, and I wondered where he'd gone. So he was living as a demon called Barbatos.
Enough about him. I'll tell you what you want to know.
strings.마계가 심연에서 태어나는 악마와 그런 악마를 따르는 족속들이 있는 공간이: The Demon Realm houses demons born from the abyss and those who follow them. The Celestial Realm was where gods and their followers dwelled.
strings.원래는 사람들 앞에 그 모습을 드러내지 않지만, 신이 사라지면서 이 세계: It normally remains hidden from people, but after the gods disappeared, parts seem to have emerged as it naturally merged with this world.
strings.신이 사라졌다고 해도, 그들의 힘이 남은 천계의 일부이기에 조각이라 불리: Even with the gods gone, those fragments of the Celestial Realm retained their power. That's probably how they endured so long.
But another power's influence can change them.
strings.바르바토스와 함께 모습을 드러낸 게 '아마란스 노바'인 것 같아. 신의: I think Amaranth Nova appeared along with Barbatos. A star of the abyss appearing in a place filled with divine power...
strings.예전에 제 손에 쓰러진 나쁜 마법사가 있는데, '모든 상처와 눈물을 토하: An evil mage I defeated once called one 'a star of the abyss that pours out every wound and tear.'
Sounds like he deserved a lesson.
strings.어쨌든 기존에 있던 신의 힘과 심연의 별이 남긴 마계의 힘이 뒤섞여 린포: In any case, if Linford changed because its divine power mixed with the demonic power left by an abyssal star, something is strange...
strings.그런 장소로 변했다면 우리가 밟고 있는 프레이오스 대륙은 이미 사라졌어야: If it became such a place, the continent of Freios beneath our feet should already be gone. A mere earthquake wouldn't have been the end of it.
strings.내가 이곳을 벗어날 수 있으면 확인해 줄 수 있을 텐데…. 천사들은 신탁: If I could leave here, I'd investigate for you. Angels can act independently of an oracle.
Thank you for offering. I'll handle the rest.
strings.그래, 알겠어. 그럼 이제 어디로 갈 거야?: All right. Where will you go now?
What about Elysia? A divine place you can enter freely...
Hold still a moment. Take my greeting before you go.
strings.(우리엘라가 다가가 살며시 볼 키스를 한다.): (Uriella approaches and gently kisses the adventurer's cheek.)
Hehe. Still surprised. Come see me again once this is resolved.
I promise, Uriella. I'll go now.
strings.(모험가를 배웅하던 우리엘라가 조용히 그를 따라가는 누군가의 모습에 눈을: (Seeing the adventurer off, Uriella closes her eyes at the sight of someone following them quietly.)
It's been a while, old man.
After causing all that commotion, you two come together... So it must be that matter.
We came to ask for help.
strings.무슨 말인지 알고 있네. 평소 같으면 호통을 쳐서 쫓아냈겠지만 이번만은: I know what you mean. Normally I'd shout and send you away, but I'll make an exception.
If you have any good-quality jewels from magical beasts, share them with me.
strings.그래, 그런 보석. 없으면 가서 구해 오고. 자세한 건 보석을 받은 후에: Yes, those. If you have none, fetch some. I'll explain after I receive them.
Fine jewels. They'll make good gifts for my family when they're reborn... Thank you.
strings.그런데 이건 왜 부탁하셨죠?: Why did you ask for these?
Go to where you caused that commotion before.
strings.(헤카테가 쓸쓸한 눈빛으로 먼 하늘을 바라보더니 이내 눈을 감는다.): (Hecate gazes at the distant sky with lonely eyes, then closes them.)
strings.(헤카테가 눈을 떠 다가오는 두 사람과 눈을 맞춘다.): (Hecate opens her eyes and looks at the approaching pair.)
Hilda, following the mortal back to Elysia... You must have made a great resolve.
I see. I, too, have no choice.
strings.가이아와 세레스의 사랑을 받고 성계신이 된 그 아이…. 이리스의 의지가: The girl loved by Gaia and Seres, who became the God of the Astral Realm... Iris has made a momentous choice.
To issue you an oracle to destroy Barbatos, who was Kaulini.
You do not fully understand what that means.
strings.이리스가 내 제안을 거절한 건 그렇다 쳐도, 신탁은 신으로서 필멸자에게: Her rejecting my proposal is one thing. But an oracle is a god's command to a mortal...
strings.그 순간부터 더욱 '신'이란 존재에 가까워진다. 그리고 더는 인간으로 돌: From that moment, she moves closer to being a god. And can no longer return to being human.
She must have chosen the best path available from where she stands.
That is all I wished to say. Expect no help from me.
Had Iris accepted my proposal, I might have thought differently.
strings.힐다, 너도 내게 묻고 싶은 게 있겠지. 하지만, 너도 알겠지. 내가 녹: Hilda, you have questions for me, too. But you know I am not easily swayed.
Do not forget. I am a god. The one who gave you the fate of witches...
And the reason I awakened to watch these events...
Hecate, Hilda and I are going to a fragment of the Celestial Realm...
Menoiti, I will withdraw. If you wish to do something, do as you please.
strings.(그 말과 함께 헤카테의 모습이 연기처럼 흩어지더니 모습을 감춘다. 잠시: (Hecate's figure disperses like smoke and vanishes. A moment later, a boy carrying a chalice approaches from the path behind them and taps %s's shoulder.)
strings.키 작고 뒤틀린 자가 왜 여기 있지?: What's a short Twisted One doing here?
strings.여긴 엘리시아잖아. 소소한 부분은 신경 쓰지 마. 그건 그렇고 헤카테는: This is Elysia. Don't worry about little details. Hecate really can't be honest with herself.
strings.아무것도 안 하려고 엘리시아에 왔는데, 쉬고 있던 날 불러 놓고 사라지다: I came here to do nothing, and she called me away from my rest, only to disappear.
strings.분명 마음대로 하라고 했으니까 멋대로 해도 되겠지?: She clearly said to do as I please. So I may, right?
strings.(메노이티가 환하게 웃으며 손에 든 잔을 하늘을 향해 치켜든다.): (Menoiti smiles brightly and lifts his cup toward the sky.)
I wish it were a lie... It has to stop... Everyone will be in danger...
A horned woman with sad eyes...
strings.모르는 사람이야. 그런데 어디서 본 것 같은 느낌이 들어…. 그런데 여기: No. But she feels familiar... Where are we?
On the road to where you wanted to go.
In front of the windmill on Whispering Hill...
strings.메노이티라고 했지? 혹시 너도 환영 봤어?: Menoiti, was it? Did you see the vision, too?
strings.내가 너희를 데리고 여기에 오는 와중에 대놓고 보여주던데, 못 볼 리가: It was displayed openly while I brought you here. Of course I saw it.
strings.혹시 누군지 알아?: Do you know who she is?
I don't know the name of every spirit in the world.
strings.그래, 정령이잖아. 아, 너희는 봐도 모르겠구나. 어쨌든 이런 걸 두 사: Yes, a spirit. Oh, you can't tell just by looking. Anyway, someone seems to want you two to see this.
strings.그게 누군지 알고 싶겠지만 나도 몰라. 각자 자신만의 능력이란 게 있으니: You'd like to know who, but I don't know, either. Everyone has their own abilities.
Juriring, stop hiding and come here.
Nice to meet you, Juriring. I'm Menoiti.
strings.메노이티, 메노이티…. 들어 본 적 있어요. 링. 옛날에, 옛날에 사라졌: Menoiti, Menoiti... I've heard of you, ring. A god who disappeared long, long ago, ring.
Ancient history. Now I'm just a short Twisted One with barely a name left.
strings.뒤, 뒤, 뒤틀린 자! 링! 저 처음 봤어요! 링! 거기다 키 작은 자!: A T-T-Twisted One, ring! I've never seen one, ring! And a short one, too!
Wow, a giant Priring... Not an ordinary Priring, surely...
Iris said it's a kind of Spirit King.
strings.쥬리링, 내가 네 보석에 물방울을 떨어뜨려도 될까? 보석이 지금보다 더: Juriring, may I put a drop of water on your jewel? It'll shine even more brightly.
strings.(메노이티가 잔을 살짝 흔들자 반짝거리는 물방울이 살며시 날아올라 쥬리링: (Menoiti gently shakes his cup. A sparkling droplet rises and lands on Juriring's jewel.)
Wow... It's so shiny, ring. One moment, ring.
strings.(쥬리링이 눈을 깜빡이며 날개로 보석을 닦는다.): (Juriring blinks and polishes the jewel with a wing.)
strings.응원한 지 얼마 안 됐는데, 또 해 봐야겠어요. 링. 그런데 뭐라고 할까: I only just cheered, but I should try again, ring. What should I say?
Wish for everyone's happiness and well-being as usual. I'll handle the rest.
Ring, ring. Be happy, ring. Stay healthy, ring, ring.
(Juriring lifts and shakes the jewel toward the sky. Gentle light blooms and spreads.)
strings.(바로 그 순간, 메노이티가 팔을 들어 올리자 하늘로 번진 빛이 모여들어: (At that moment, Menoiti raises his arm. The light gathers from the sky and fills his cup.)
O star loved and praised by all, bearing a destiny of destruction.
Part the barrier concealing this place, and welcome the approaching light...
strings.(메노이티의 말과 함께 잔에 담긴 빛이 요동치며 용의 형상으로 변해 간다: (At Menoiti's words, the light in his cup surges into the shape of a dragon. It soars into the sky and strikes something enormous.)
That seems to have done it.
I did my part, and priests elsewhere were using their power. It worked out.
The door to the fragment of the Celestial Realm is open. You can go now.
Amazing, ring. No one could do it before, ring. Oh, %s, ring.
Oh, right, %s, ring. I said I'd tell you about Kaulini, ring.
strings.제가 본 카울리니는 온몸에 멸망의 기운을 두르고 있었어요. 링. 마치 세: The Kaulini I saw was wrapped in the presence of destruction, ring. He looked as though he'd destroy the world, ring.
He killed many gods in anger, ring. As many as the Beast killed, ring.
strings.살았다고 해야 할지, 잘 도망갔다고 해야 할지. 쥬리링, 너 오래 살았구: Survived, or escaped well, perhaps. Juriring, you've lived a long time. You remember that.
I have a good memory, ring.
strings.(그래서 머리와 다리에 붕대를 감고 있나….): (Is that why his head and leg are bandaged...?)
Belial's deception was part of it, but I think there was something more, ring.
I don't know, ring. I've never left this hill, so I don't know, ring.
That seems to be the end of the story. Off you go.
You think this is helping? You really know nothing about the Twisted Ones.
strings.내 마음이 변하면 저번에 만났을 때처럼 방해할지도 몰라. 우물쭈물하지 말: If I change my mind, I may obstruct you like last time. Stop hesitating and go.
strings.그래, 갈게. 아, 쥬리링. 엘리엇은 지금 어디에 있어?: All right. Oh, Juriring, where's Elliot?
It's mealtime, so he'll be at the Cloud's Threshold, ring.
strings.(쥬리링이 힐다와 모험가를 배웅하고서 자신을 쓰다듬는 메노이티를 바라본다: (Juriring sees Hilda and the adventurer off, then looks at Menoiti, who is stroking it.)
strings.메노이티 님, 뭐 하고 놀아요? 링?: Menoiti, what shall we play, ring?
Juriring, want to visit Atlas Garden? There's an amusing friend there, too.
Patello drains all my motivation... Just hurry up and leave...
Oh, I was talking to myself. Don't worry about it, Elliot.
It's fine, it's fine. Guests in our village needn't worry.
strings.아, 라셀리스 셰프님. 여기 있는 것만 다 먹고 고장 난 오븐하고 구멍: Oh, Chef Raselis. Once I finish this, I'll look at your broken oven and the hole in the roof.
strings.…파텔로 아저씨 때문에 오븐이 쉴 틈이 없네. 여기저기 마을 건물들 지붕: ...The oven never gets a rest because of Patello. Neither do the roofs around the village.
It was scary when something fell from the sky...
strings.겁먹을 필요 없어. 나도 처음에는 마수나 악마들이 몰려오는 줄 알았다니까: No need to be frightened. I thought magical beasts or demons were attacking at first, too.
Hello, everyone. Here you all are.
strings.선생님께 잠깐 마을을 떠난다고 들었는데 다시 왔네. 일단 여기 앉아서 식: Master said you were leaving the village briefly. You're back already. Sit down and eat first.
strings.아, 미안해요, 엘리엇. 못 봤어요. 식사 다 했죠?: Oh, sorry, Elliot. I didn't see you. Have you finished eating?
I have. Did you need to tell me something...?
There's somewhere we need to go together.
strings.잘 다녀와. 혹시 모르니까 먹을 것도 챙겨 가고. 선생님께는 내가 말해: Have a safe trip. Take some food, just in case. I'll tell Master.
Thank you... I'll explore properly this time...
strings.(엘리엇이 레스토랑 밖에서 기다리고 있는 힐다를 알아보고 놀란다.): (Outside the restaurant, Elliot recognizes Hilda waiting and startles.)
It's been so long, and that's how you greet me...?
We're going to Linford. We need you to guide us.
The blocked road seems to be open.
Until recently, all I could do was look from here...
strings.(엘리엇이 고개를 숙이며 겨우 참고 있던 눈물을 터뜨린다.): (Elliot lowers his head and finally lets his tears fall.)
I needed to do something, so someone helped me...
strings.아무도 못 한 일을 해낸 분이라면 분명 훌륭하고 대단한 분이시겠죠…?: Someone who did what no one else could must be truly wonderful and remarkable...?
Straight ahead. There are several branches, but they're all blocked.
strings.그런데 말예요, 린포드로 향하는 아이테르 가도는 예전 모습 그대로인데 대: But Aether Road looks just as it used to... What could have happened?
We'll have to go and see.
strings.네가 린포드에서 나온 건 3년 전이라고 하지만, 실제로 여긴 10년 전부: You say you left Linford three years ago, but this road has been blocked for ten. Clearly something's wrong.
strings.마수 둥지 탐험했을 때처럼 잘 숨어 있을 수 있지?: You can hide well, like when you explored the beasts' nest, right?
strings.아이테르 가도는 그렇게 위험하지 않아요…. 작은 프리링만 있는 그런 길이: Aether Road isn't that dangerous... It's just a road with little Prirings...
strings.(가도를 가득 채운 구름이 물러나면서, 그동안 보이지 않던 몬스터들의 모: (The clouds filling the road retreat, slowly revealing previously hidden monsters.)
If they're water spirits from the river...
They look familiar. I'm not sure...
Linford will be all right, Elliot.
Yes... Hearing you say that is reassuring.
Elliot, follow behind and guide us.
strings.주변 공기가 바뀌었어…. 뭐지? 그동안 구름이 걷힌 적은 거의 없었는데…: The air has changed... Why? The clouds have hardly ever cleared...
strings.(녹빛의 긴 머리를 쓸어넘긴 엘프 여성이 조용히 눈을 감고는 손을 들어: (An elven woman brushes back her long green hair, quietly closes her eyes, and gently touches the air.)
...People are coming, not monsters. Unbelievable. Real people...
strings.(엘프 여성이 봉을 들고 있는 손에 살짝 힘을 주고는 자신이 있는 방향으: (The elf tightens her grip on her staff and leaps toward the approaching figures.)
strings.(가도를 가득 채울 정도로 커다란 소리와 함께 봉 끝을 내리찍은 자리에: (With a sound loud enough to fill the road, the staff strikes the ground and leaves a great hole.)
Wow... If Hilda hadn't pulled me away, that would've been bad...
strings.지금 감탄할 때가 아니잖아. 괜찮아?: This isn't the time to admire it. Are you all right?
strings.(헤일리라고 불린 엘프 여성이 놀란 표정으로 엘리엇을 바라본다.): (The elf called Hailey looks at Elliot in surprise.)
strings.어, 어? 너, 벤자민네 막내 아들 맞지? 너는 10년 전에 린포드를 떠: Oh? You're Benjamin's youngest son, right? You left Linford ten years ago... You're back.
strings.그런데 왜 나이를 안 먹었지? 벤자민 아들이라서 어려 보이는 건 이해가: But why haven't you aged? I understand looking young when you're Benjamin's son, but...
strings.그건 그렇고 여기는 어떻게 들어왔어? 10년 동안 아무도 들어올 수도 나: How did you get in? No one has entered or left in ten years.
strings.속삭임의 언덕 말고는 들어오는 길이 없을 텐데…. 거기서 올라온 거야?: The only way in should be from Whispering Hill... Did you come from there?
strings.(헤일리가 말을 끝내기 무섭게 속삭임의 언덕으로 향하는 길로 뛰어간다.): (Before her words have faded, Hailey runs down the road toward Whispering Hill.)
strings.제가 여행을 떠나기 전에 마을을 찾아온 엘프예요. 저희 집에서 잠깐 묵으: An elf who visited the village before I left to travel. She stayed at our house briefly, so I know her a little.
I think she said she's a high elf who hunts demons and witches...
strings.조용히 할게요. 제가 있던 도로시 마을에 대해서 이야기할 리는 없겠지만,: I'll keep quiet. I wouldn't mention Dorothy Village, but I'm afraid I might slip...
strings.골치 아픈 여자네. 미리 좀 숨어 있을 걸…. 안 그래도 교단에 소속된: A troublesome woman. I should have hidden first... There are a few elves like her among the Order's hardliners...
strings.(헤일리가 전력을 다해 뛰어오다가 세 사람 앞에서 멈춘다.): (Hailey races back at full speed and stops before them.)
strings.후우, 역시 나갈 수 없었어. 너희만 특별하게 들어올 수 있었던 것 같아: Whew. Still can't get out. It seems you were specially allowed in. Have you checked whether you can leave?
I did. Don't worry. You and I can leave...
Hailey, they're good people. Please don't suspect them...
strings.%s, 이분은 여러 곳에서 많은 도움을 주셨어요…. 리프트라시르에 나쁜: %s has helped in many places... They defeated the evil witch who appeared in Lifthrasir.
strings.소장님을 아시는군요. 틈만 나면 리프트라시르 주민이 되어 달라고 하셔서: You know the director. Whenever she gets a chance, she asks me to become a resident of Lifthrasir. It's quite an ordeal.
strings.곤욕이라고 하니까 진짜 같네. 리프 언니가 그 정도로 들이댄 걸 보면 당: Calling it an ordeal makes you sound genuine. If Lif pushed that hard, you must be someone remarkable.
strings.이쪽은 %s? 여기 오드아이가 힐다라고 했나? 반가워. 난 헤일리야. 편: So you're %s? And the one with mismatched eyes is Hilda? Nice to meet you. I'm Hailey. Just call me that. Welcome.
strings.무슨 일로 왔는지는 묻지 않을게. 당연히 해야 할 일이 있어서 왔을 테니: I won't ask why you're here. You must have something to do...
strings.어려운 이야기지만, 나만 아는 린포드의 비밀을 이야기해 줄게. 이건 저주: It's difficult, but I'll tell you Linford's secret, one only I know. This is a curse...
Whew... After ten years, I can finally tell someone...
strings.그래, 저주…. 여기 남아 있는 사람들은 그 저주를 단순히 바깥으로 나가: Yes... The people left here think the curse simply prevents them from leaving. To me, it means something else.
strings.매일매일 여기 있는 몬스터들을 정리하면서 그 저주를 잊으려 하는데 쉽지: I clear out these monsters every day to try to forget it, but it's not easy. Spirits connected to death wander here, too...
strings.일단 근처를 어지럽히는 몬스터들을 정리하고서 그 저주가 뭔지 이야기해 줄: Let's deal with the monsters causing trouble nearby first. Then I'll explain the curse.
Good work. This lets Linford's people have better dreams.
strings.그러면 헤일리에게만 왜 '저주'의 의미가 다른지 말씀해 주시겠어요?: Will you explain why the curse means something different to you?
strings.그래, 이야기해 줄게. 이 이야기를 믿을지 말지는 %s 네 선택에 달렸지: Yes. Whether you believe it is your choice, %s...
strings.10년 전, 나는 원수와 같은 마족을 쫓아 린포드로 오게 됐어. 그 마족: Ten years ago, I came to Linford pursuing a demon I considered my mortal enemy. I couldn't find it and was about to leave, thinking I'd wasted my time...
strings.린포드는 알 수 없는 강력한 힘으로 인해 그 누구도 바깥으로 나갈 수 없: But an unknown, powerful force had made it impossible for anyone to leave.
strings.무슨 일인지 알아보기 위해 다시 마을로 돌아오던 그때, 땅이 흔들리고 갈: As I returned to the village to investigate, the ground began shaking and splitting.
And bottomless black holes appeared beneath Linford.
strings.하늘 위에 떠 있던 거대한 천사의 도시가 강력한 힘으로 갈라져 그대로 구: The enormous city of angels floating in the sky split under that power and fell toward the holes.
strings.검은 구멍으로 떨어지는 사람들을 어떻게든 구해 보려고 했지만, 너무 순식: I tried to save the people falling into them, but it happened too quickly. There was nothing I could do.
strings.떨어지는 건물의 잔해를 밟으면서 겨우겨우 올라가려고 했지만, 그런 상황이: I struggled upward, stepping on falling rubble. But as it continued, my strength reached its limit.
strings.그러다가 발을 잘못 디뎌 그대로 검은 구멍으로 떨어질 뻔했는데… 그 순간: Then I missed a step and nearly fell into a black hole... A woman with white wings appeared and caught my hand.
strings.천사의 도시에 진짜 천사가 나타나 날 구해 주는 그 순간이 마치 꿈같아서: A real angel in the city of angels, saving me... It felt so dreamlike that I closed my eyes without thinking.
Everything went quiet. When it became noisy again, I opened my eyes...
strings.무너지지 않은 본래 모습 그대로의 린포드 중심에 서 있었어. 사람들도 그: And stood in the center of Linford, intact, just as before. Everyone was still there.
strings.누구도 린포드에 검은 구멍이 생겼단 사실을 알지 못했어. 마치 재생된 것: No one knew black holes had appeared. It was as though everything had been restored, and only I remembered.
strings.나는 서둘러 밖으로 나가려고 했지만, 지금과 마찬가지로 나갈 수가 없었어: I hurried to leave, but couldn't, just like now.
The people only knew their city was cursed and they couldn't go outside...
strings.이 정도면 내가 알고 있는 '저주'와 사람들이 알고 있는 '저주'의 의미: Now you understand how my curse differs from theirs...
That's hard to believe. Then the people in Linford now...
I think it's true. Those people might be...
strings.그래서 내가 처음에 말했잖아. 이걸 믿을지 말지는 네 선택이라고. 후우…: That's why I said believing it is your choice. Whew... I feel better after saying it.
strings.그동안 누구에게도 제대로 말하지 못했어. 이야기해도 아무도 믿어 주지 않: I couldn't tell anyone properly. No one believed me...
strings.나조차 착각이 아닐까 의심했지만, 얼마 후 하늘에서 속삭임의 언덕 방향으: I even doubted myself. But later, I saw an angel fly toward Whispering Hill and return. Then I knew.
strings.천사를 쫓아가 물어보려 했지만 금세 사라져 버렸어. 그 후로도 가끔씩 나: I followed to ask, but she vanished quickly. She appeared now and then afterward, seemingly searching for a way out...
strings.어느 순간부터 포기했는지 모습을 드러내지 않더라고. 린포드 어딘가에 있긴: At some point, she stopped appearing. Maybe she gave up. I think she's still somewhere in Linford...
strings.천사조차 어떻게 할 수 없는 상황이라면, 천사의 힘보다 강한 무언가가 여: If even an angel can't do anything, a power greater than hers must be at work here.
I suspected it... Divine power, then...
If someone did this, I want to meet them and ask why. Sigh.
strings.(아직은 믿기 어렵지만, 확인해 봐야겠어.): (Still hard to believe, but I need to check.)
Oh, and afterward, a place appeared off to one side that wasn't there before.
It resembles part of Linford, but feels different. I can't approach easily.
strings.다가가려고 하면 마치 접근을 허락하지 않는 듯이 점점 멀어지거든. 끝까지: When I try, it keeps moving farther away, as though denying entry. I can never reach it.
And... It looks frozen at the moment I survived.
You're speaking calmly, but it must have been terribly hard.
Perhaps because high elves live so long. Easier than for a human, I suppose.
strings.내가 안내해 주고 싶지만, 해야 할 일이 있어서 먼저 마을로 돌아가야 할: I'd like to guide you, but I have work to do. I need to return to the village first.
Keep this story secret from the villagers.
strings.그리고 %s 님, 힐다, 저 먼저 마을로 가도 될까요? 확인하고 싶은 게: %s, Hilda, may I go to the village first? There's something I want to check...
Go see your family. We'll talk later.
Thank you both... I'll go ahead.
Is that the place Hailey mentioned? It resembles the village in the distance...
strings.누가 자꾸 쓸데없는 걸 보여 주지…. 신경이 쓰이긴 하지만, 그냥 가야겠: Who keeps showing me useless things...? It bothers me, but I should just go.
strings.(아이테르 가도의 한적한 장소, 한 여성이 귀찮은 듯한 표정으로 접근 금: (In a quiet part of Aether Road, a woman stands before a forbidden area with an annoyed expression.)
strings.어, 저기 누가 있어. 그런데 저 날개는 뭐지…?: Oh, someone's there. But what are those wings...?
strings.(일행과 눈이 마주친 여성이 놀라 뒤로 물러난다. 두 손으로 어깨를 가린: (The woman meets their eyes and steps back in surprise. Covering her shoulders, she tries to flee, but Hilda quickly catches her.)
strings.으갸악, 저기 제 날개… 아, 아니 제 옷 좀 놓아주세요! 저는 두 분이: Aaagh! Please let go of my wings... I mean, my clothes! You appeared so suddenly that I was startled...
strings.처음 뵙는 분들인데 어떻게 린포드에 오셨죠? 저주 때문에 아무도 오갈 수: I've never seen you before. How did you come to Linford? No one can enter or leave because of the curse...
We came on business. About those wings on your back...
Ahaha, wings...? What wings? What are you talking about? Ahaha...
strings.당신 등에서 자라다 만 것처럼 있는 그거 말이야. 깃털 끝이 검은 걸 보: The things on your back that look half-grown. Black feather tips... Like a pigeon or a seagull...
That's rather rude for someone I've just met...
strings.…역시 날개에 반응하는군요. 날개를 가진 마족?: ...Definitely reacting to the wings. A winged demon?
strings.신의 축복을 받은 분이 무례하시네요. 제 날개는 마족 같은 것과 다르다고: How rude for someone blessed by a god. My wings are nothing like a demon's! And Hailey would have killed me already if I were one!
strings.아, 아니요. 여행 중에 린포드의 저주에 갇혀 돌아가지 못하는 그런 존재: N-no. Just a being... A woman trapped by Linford's curse while traveling. A-Ariel, that's all.
strings.산책하는 걸 좋아하는 20대 후반에 키는 160센치 정도인 인간 여성이라: A human woman in her late twenties, about 160 centimeters tall, who likes walks...
strings.평범한 사람이 자신을 '인간'이라고 굳이 짚어서 이야기하지 않아. 게다가: Ordinary people don't specifically call themselves human. And why does that introduction sound like a character profile?
strings.아리엘도 애칭이 있어요? 제가 아는 전투 천사들은 다들 스스로를 애칭으로: Do you have a nickname, Ariel? All the battle angels I know call themselves by pet names. Would yours be 'Ar'? 'Ar does this,' 'Ar does that'...
strings.제발 부탁드릴게요. 모든 천사가 다 그 바보들처럼 말하진 않는다고요. 흑: Please, I'm begging you. Not every angel talks like those idiots. Sob... Please...
strings.아리엘, 제 소개를 할게요. 저는 %s…. 신탁을 받아 이곳으로 오게 됐: Ariel, let me introduce myself. I'm %s... I came here under an oracle. Nice to meet you.
strings.…난 힐다. 당신이 헤일리가 말한 천사지?: ...I'm Hilda. You're the angel Hailey mentioned?
strings.사정이 있으신 것 같은데, 도와주시면 최대한 상황을 봐드릴게요. 거절하셔: You seem to have your reasons. Help us, and I'll take them into account. You're free to refuse, but I wonder how the God of the Astral Realm would react later...
strings.여기서 천사 임무 같은 건 영영 하지 않는 채로 살고 있는데, 갑자기 그: I've been living here without doing any angelic duties at all. And now you suddenly say that...
No other option, is there? Sigh...
...You're better at that than I expected.
strings.우, 망했어…. 그런데 저는 성계신 자리가 비어 있는 걸로 알고 있는데…: Oh, I'm doomed... But I thought the seat of the God of the Astral Realm was vacant...
strings.아리엘은 지난 10년 사이에 벌어진 일 같은 건 모르고 있나요? 역시 여: Do you know nothing about the last ten years? Because you've been here, I suppose...?
strings.(아리엘에게 간단하게 이리스가 성계신이 됐다고 이야기한다.): (I briefly explain that Iris became the God of the Astral Realm.)
strings.그렇군요. 그런데 '아마란스 노바' 앞에는 무슨 일로 오신 거예요?: I see. But why have you come to Amaranth Nova?
strings.(모험가가 이곳으로 온 이유를 설명하자 아리엘이 조용히 시선을 앞으로 옮: (As the adventurer explains, Ariel quietly turns her gaze forward.)
strings.이 앞에 있는 게 그곳이 맞긴 해요. 신의 힘으로 불러온, 심연 속 거대: Yes, this is the place. Where an enormous star from the abyss, summoned by divine power, rose and fell...
strings.강력한 신의 힘이 작용하는 곳이기 때문에 이 안으로 들어가고 싶다면 그곳: Powerful divine forces operate here. If you want to enter, you must listen to the being within.
I'd rather not talk about him...
strings.제게서 이야기를 듣고 싶다면 먼저 마을을 다녀오세요. 일단 다녀오시면 무: If you want to hear my story, visit the village first. You'll understand when you do.
Can angels not speak freely about gods? Some kind of rule...?
strings.(아리엘이 뭔가를 이어 말하지만, 목소리가 흘러나오지 않는다.): (Ariel continues speaking, but no sound comes out.)
No choice... Hilda, let's visit the village as Ariel says.
strings.엘리엇, 아빠는 10년 동안 우리 아들 얼굴을 잊은 적이 없단다…. 돌아: Elliot, your father never forgot your face in all ten years... I'm so glad you're back.
strings.(엘리엇이 더는 참지 못하고 울음을 터뜨리자, 그와 분위기가 비슷한 남자: (Elliot can hold back no longer and bursts into tears. A man with a similar air pats his shoulder.)
You've been through so much. I'm sorry I couldn't come find you...
No... I missed you so much...
strings.이 기쁜 소식을 리아나에게도 알려야 하는데, 알지? 너희 누나는 일할 때: We must tell Liana this wonderful news. But you know your sister hates being interrupted while working.
The general store closes in the evening. Let's wait until then.
strings.아직도 기분이 이상하구나. 열넷에 린포드를 떠난 널 10년 만에 보는데: This still feels strange. You left Linford at fourteen. Ten years later, you're seventeen...
It's strange for me, too. It's only been three years for me, but you say ten...
I don't understand, either. Where did the rest of the time go...?
Still, I should be grateful I can see you again before you're fully grown.
strings.혹시 아빠, 10년 전 저주가 시작된 날을 기억하세요?: Dad, do you remember the day the curse began ten years ago?
I do. The ground shook terribly, like an earthquake.
Hmm. I don't remember anything else. Nothing much must have happened.
Is that his brother? They look alike.
strings.아, %s. 님. 힐다. 마을로 오셨네요. 헤일리는 절 데려다주고 다른: Oh, %s. Hilda. You came to the village. Hailey brought me here, then went elsewhere.
strings.베, 벤자민이라고 합니다. 제 아들, 엘리엇에게 많은 도움을 주셨다고 들: I-I'm Benjamin. I heard you've helped my son Elliot a great deal... Thank you.
strings.안녕하세요…. 저는 %s…입니다. 형인 줄 알았는데 아버지라고 하셔서 놀: Hello... I'm %s. I thought you were his brother, so that surprised me.
strings.외부인을 보기는 오랜만이라 조금 긴장…했네요. 엘리엇에게서 길이 열렸다고: It's been so long since I met outsiders that I'm a little nervous... Elliot said the road opened, but it seems we still can't leave...
strings.언제쯤 밖으로 나갈 수 있을지…. 저를 포함해서 린포드 주민들은 모두 포: When will we be able to leave...? Everyone in Linford, myself included, had given up. Seeing you gives me a little hope...
I'm sorry I can't explain in detail...
strings.아닙니다. 이렇게 엘리엇을 보게 해 주신 것만으로 감사드릴 뿐입니다. 린: Not at all. I'm grateful simply to see Elliot again. Linford will manage somehow.
strings.계시는 동안 별일 없이 지내셨으면 합니다. 도움이 필요하시면 언제든 말씀: I hope your stay is peaceful. Tell me if you need help. I'll do anything I can.
strings.저 잠깐 두 분과 이야기 좀 하고 와도 될까요?: May I talk to these two for a moment?
Perfect. I was about to ask Elliot to show us around.
strings.엘리엇, 두 분과 이야기하면서 둘러보고 와. 오랜만이잖니…. 아빠는 어디: Go talk and look around, Elliot. It's been so long... I won't go anywhere. Come back when you have time.
strings.(벤자민이 집으로 들어가는 모습을 확인한 엘리엇이 식은 땀을 흘리며 자리: (Once Benjamin enters the house, Elliot breaks into a cold sweat and sinks to the ground.)
strings.저도 모르게 그만…. 헤일리의 이야기를 들어서 그런지… 분명 아빠가 맞는: I couldn't help it... Maybe because of Hailey's story... He's definitely Dad, but it feels strange. And...
strings.…아버지의 기억이 이상해요. 리아나 누나는 결혼해서 글래스턴에 살고 있어: ...His memories are wrong. My sister Liana married and lives in Glaston... She worked at the general store before her marriage...
We should see whether anything is strange about the other villagers, too...
If Kiril still has the same job, he'll be at the shop.
strings.사람들이 많이 방문하는 잡화점이어서 이런저런 이야기를 들을 수 있거든요…: Lots of people visit the general store. We can hear all sorts of things...
Wait a moment. I'll go check...
strings.엘리엇, 다시 봐도 그대로구나. 10년 전하고 똑같아. 벤자민 아저씨를: Elliot, you're still exactly the same. Just like ten years ago. Is it because you inherited Benjamin's young face?
Welcome. Oh, outsiders? You must be the people Elliot mentioned.
Elliot said he'd greet you first so we wouldn't startle you.
strings.하하, 괜찮습니다. 그런데 제게는 딱히 도움을 드릴 만한 정보가 없는데…: Haha, it's fine. But I don't have much useful information...
Kiril, just tell us what you remember from ten years ago...
strings.며칠 전에 먹은 음식도 잘 기억나질 않는데 10년 전이라…. 그래도 노력: I can barely remember what I ate a few days ago, and you want ten years... I'll try.
strings.도시에 저주가 걸린 날은 어땠나요?: What was the day the city was cursed like?
There was something like an earthquake.
strings.안 그래도 모든 재산을 투자한 가게가 지진 때문에 망하는 꼴을 볼까 봐: I was afraid it would ruin the shop I'd invested everything in, so I just sat down and clung to it.
Embarrassing, but I couldn't think what else to do.
It felt like we were falling, and I was frightened. But the shaking soon stopped.
strings.그래서 다음 날 다른 지역에서 들어오는 물건을 받을 수 있겠거니 했는데,: I thought I'd receive the goods from other regions the next day, then learned we were trapped.
Then I thought I really was ruined. Somehow, I've held on until now.
strings.어디에서 무슨 물건을 받기로 했는지 기억해?: Do you remember what goods you ordered and where from?
I think they were ingredients for something popular then... Strange. I can't remember clearly.
strings.글래스턴에서 유행하던 쿠키 있잖아요. 그걸 만든다고 여러 도시에서 재료를: Those cookies popular in Glaston? You bought up ingredients from several cities to make them... Was that it?
Oh, yes. I think so. Paid an enormous amount for them, didn't I...?
Haha, this happens sometimes. I'm no longer young, so I forget things.
strings.엘리엇을 10년 전에 봤는데 왜 아직도 그 모습 그대로냐…. 그날에 땅이: They last saw Elliot ten years ago, so why does he still look the same? The ground shook that day, but nothing else happened...
They seem to be telling the truth, but there's another common thread.
strings.다들 기억의 혼선이 있어요…. 3년 전, 아니…. 저 말고 마을 사람들: Their memories are mixed up... Three years ago... No, ten years ago from their perspective. There seem to be wrong memories...
strings.키릴 형이 말한 기억도 진짜가 아니에요…. 쿠키는 그냥 제가 해 본 말이: Kiril's memory wasn't real, either... I just made up the cookies...
I wanted to try them. So they were imaginary.
strings.흠…. 그런데 너는 누구야? 왜 계속 따라오지?: Hmm... But who are you? Why do you keep following us?
I've never seen you before. I'm curious.
strings.(어린 소녀 하나가 분주하게 움직이는 %s 일행이 신기한 듯 옆에서 함께: (A young girl walks beside %s's busy group, watching them with interest.)
I think you were only a baby when I left to travel...
strings.린포드에는 아기가 태어나면 사람들이 그 집에 가서 직접 쓴 편지를 전달하: In Linford, when a baby is born, people visit the home and give handwritten letters.
strings.저도 그때 태어난 지 얼마 안된 샤를에게 인사를 했거든요. 역시 남의 집: I greeted Charl when she was newborn. Do other people's children really grow so fast?
strings.이 아이가 벌써 열 살이 넘었다는 소린데…. …이제야 실감이 나요. 제게: She must be over ten already... It's finally sinking in. Time passed strangely for me...
strings.10년 전 이야기인데, 너는 그때 너무 어려서 기억이 안 날 것 같아서…: It's about ten years ago. You were too young to remember... Sorry...
I think I can tell you something interesting.
strings.제가 언젠가부터 이상한 걸 봤는데요…. 말로 설명하기 힘든데…. 언제부터: I've been seeing strange things... It's hard to explain... They started appearing in the city.
strings.엄마는 잘 모르겠다면서 옆집 할아버지에게 물어보랬어요. 그래서 물어보니까: Mom didn't know, so she told me to ask the old man next door. He said they're spirits that live in water.
They want to drag dead people into the river...
strings.그런데 저하고 린포드 사람들은 살아 있잖아요…. 이상하죠?: But the people of Linford and I are alive... Strange, isn't it?
strings.다른 사람들은 안 믿는데, 헤일리 선생님은 믿어 주시더라고요. 그래서 종: Other people don't believe me, but Teacher Hailey does. When I tell her, she goes out to the road...
strings.비밀리에 뭔가를 잡고 계신 것 같은데, 그게 그 정령인 거죠?: She seems to be hunting something secretly. Those spirits, right?
I'm sorry. I can't tell you.
It's all right. Adults are always like that... Everything's a secret.
strings.비밀 지켜 주면 나중에 커다란 프리링 보여 줄게. 네가 프리링을 좋아하는: If you keep the secret, I'll show you a giant Priring later. You seem to like Prirings... It looks something like this.
strings.그렇게 큰 프리링이 있어요…? 날개도 있어요? 아, 보고 싶다…. 만나면: There's a Priring that big...? With wings? Oh, I want to see it... It'd be fun to meet...
strings.응, 약속. 저기 엘리엇, 이 아이를 데려다줘요. 뭔가 알게 되면 나중에: I promise. Elliot, please take her home. If we learn anything, I'll tell you later.
strings.…그 프리링 말고 재미있게 말하는 약초 정령 이야기도 해 줄게. 샤를,: ...I'll tell you about a funny-talking herb spirit, too, besides that Priring. Charl, I'll walk you home. Come on.
strings.하아…. 언제까지 말할 수 없는 거야…. 아?: Sigh... How long will I be unable to speak...? Oh?
strings.(아리엘이 놀라 주위를 두리번거리다가 %s 일행이 뛰어오는 모습을 발견한: (Startled, Ariel looks around and sees %s's group running toward her.)
Not exactly, but everyone's memories are slightly out of step.
They seem distorted, yet the people don't notice much wrong.
strings.그리고 10년 만에 외부인이 왔다고 하면 동요해야 할 텐데 딱히 그러지도: And outsiders arriving after ten years should cause a stir, but it barely does. Most should react like Hailey.
Whew. Thank goodness. I was afraid you wouldn't notice...
We're not fools. It's obviously strange.
strings.여러분이니까 그렇게 느끼는 거예요…. 이 안에서는 저나 헤일리를 제외하면: You notice because of who you are... No one here besides Hailey and me thinks it's strange...
strings.심연으로 떨어졌다가 다시 올라온다는 건 카울리니 정도여야 가능한 일이에요: Only someone like Kaulini could fall into the abyss and rise again.
strings.그런 신이 다시 일으킨 도시와 생명은 완전하지 못해요. 도시의 겉모습 정: The city and lives restored by a god like that are incomplete. He can recreate the city's appearance, but cannot bring back the dead...
strings.그래서 그는 죽음의 강을 이곳까지 끌어와 떠내려가는 영혼을 한참 동안 건: So he drew the river of death here and spent a long time pulling drifting souls from it...
strings.지금 린포드와 린포드에 있는 생명은 겨우겨우 유지되고 있는 상태예요. 기: Linford and its lives are barely being maintained. Trapped in a fragment of the Celestial Realm, living an eternity with distorted memories...
strings.카울리니가 이곳의 어떤 모습을 기대하는지는 알 수 없지만, 아마 계속 이: I don't know what Kaulini wants this place to be, but it will probably continue like this.
strings.그나마 다행인 점은 그가 저와 헤일리를 인식하지 못했다는 것…. 그리고: The fortunate things are that he failed to notice Hailey and me... and that he properly saved Charlotte's soul...
He must have been unable to let the city's youngest child's soul drift away. He barely saved her, but since then Charl has seen spirits...
strings.어쨌든 저는 침묵할 수밖에 없었어요. 그러면 이곳에 있는 사람들은 진실을: In any case, I had no choice but to stay silent. That way, the people here could live without knowing the truth.
I'm glad you came. Someone I can finally tell...
strings.그래서 후련해요?: And that makes you feel better?
strings.천사는 생명을 초월한 존재라 그렇다 쳐도, 저 사람들은 살아 있어도 사는: Angels may transcend life, but these people are alive without truly living...
I know it isn't your fault, Ariel. But I can't call that the best choice.
As a powerless being, she had no choice. An incompetent angel, after all...
strings.이해해 주셔서 고맙긴 하지만, 무능하지는 않아요. 그저 의욕이 없을 뿐…: I appreciate the understanding, but I'm not incompetent. Just unmotivated...
strings.아마 황혼이라고 불리던 시절에 비스트, 아니면 카울리니의 손에 소멸했을: Probably destroyed by the Beast or Kaulini during the age called the Twilight.
strings.재미없는 제 이야기는 이쯤 하죠. 앞으로 어떻게 할지, 그것만 생각하세요: Enough of my dull story. Just think about what you'll do next.
And pretend you never saw me. I'm an incompetent angel, after all. Ahaha...
strings.무능 천사 아리엘, 이제 아마란스 노바에 들어갈 수 있는 거야?: Incompetent angel Ariel, can we enter Amaranth Nova now?
strings.린포드에 있는 그의 기운이 여러분을 인식하긴 했지만, 안으로 들어갈 수: His presence in Linford has recognized you, but I don't know whether you can enter. Try walking forward.
strings.(그때 아리엘의 등 뒤로 날카로운 식물 가지들이 하나둘씩 몰려들기 시작한: (At that moment, sharp plant branches begin gathering behind Ariel.)
strings.(순식간에 가지들이 아리엘의 팔과 다리와 목을 휘감고는 조금씩 조여 간다: (In an instant, branches coil around Ariel's arms, legs, and neck, tightening slowly.)
Ariel, hold on! Hilda, help! Who's doing this...?
strings.(부러진 커다란 가지 사이로 누군가가 천천히 모습을 드러낸다.): (Someone slowly emerges between great broken branches.)
strings.(한 여성이 한 손에는 은은한 빛이 맴도는 램프를, 다른 한 손에는 냉기: (A woman holds a softly glowing lamp in one hand and a sharp, icy sword in the other.)
Angel, you should have kept silent, as you have until now...
Is that Lauma? No, Giltine...? Neither...
E-Ellone... If only you hadn't gone to Belial then...
That is all in the past.
strings.그분께서 부르셨으니까요. 벨리알의 거울 속에서 재가 되어 땅에 버려졌지만: He called me. I became ash in Belial's mirror and was cast onto the earth, but he awakened me again.
I don't want to hear it...
strings.너는 모두를 살리고 싶어 했어, 벨리알이 너를 이용해서 카울리니를 타락시: You wanted to save everyone. Belial used you to corrupt Kaulini...
strings.어차피 그때의 저는… 저는…. 어, 기억이…?: At that time, I... I... Oh, my memories...?
strings.(그 말과 함께 엘로네가 들고 있던 램프가 깨지고, 그 안에 든 불꽃이: (The lamp in Ellone's hand shatters. Its flame falls to the ground and begins burning the surroundings.)
strings.아, 안 돼. 이대로 두면 불이 린포드까지 번질 거야!: N-no! If we leave it, the fire will spread to Linford!
strings.엘로네, 괴로워하지 않았어? 자책했잖아. 벨리알에게 이용당했지만 그러기를: Ellone, weren't you suffering? Blaming yourself? Belial used you, but you said you never wanted it. That it was a trap...
strings.(엘로네가 말을 더듬더니 등을 돌려 어디론가 뛰어간다.): (Ellone stammers, turns away, and runs off.)
%s, follow that spirit, Ellone or whatever she's called.
strings.이 불은 엘로네가 아니면 절대 끌 수 없어요! 이대로 두면 위험하다고요!: Only Ellone can put out this fire! It's dangerous to leave it!
Whew. Calm down and look at me, Ariel.
strings.(힐다가 아리엘을 붙잡아 조용히 바닥에 앉히고는, 단검을 꺼내 엄지손가락: (Hilda holds Ariel and quietly seats her on the ground. She takes out a dagger, cuts her thumb, and lets a drop of blood fall.)
I didn't want to see blood again, but there's no choice...
A being imperfectly restored in a space made to resemble its original form...
Kaulini, could your current state be...?
strings.뭘 그렇게 혼자 중얼거리고 있어?: What are you muttering to yourself?
strings.(엘로네가 뒤를 돌아 다가오는 모험가를 응시한다.): (Ellone turns and stares at the approaching adventurer.)
strings.서로 할 말이 있지 않아?: Don't we have things to discuss?
strings.제가 먼저 이야기할게요. 당신을 그분께 인도하겠지만, 원한다고 해서 바로: I'll speak first. I will lead you to him, but you cannot meet him simply because you wish to.
I didn't expect it to be easy.
strings.증오와 맹세의 강으로 들어와 절 만나러 오세요. 그러면 자연스럽게 아실: Come find me in the River of Hatred and Oaths. Then you'll understand naturally.
You will lose Linford and everything you love.
strings.인질로 삼고 협박까지…. 카울리니는 그런 신이 되고 싶은 거야?: Hostages and threats... Is that the kind of god Kaulini wants to be?
strings.결심이 서셨다면 천사님에게 강으로 가는 길을 물어보세요. 강 끝에서 기다: When you've decided, ask the angel for the way to the river. I'll wait at its end.
strings.(엘로네가 말을 마치자마자 어디선가 검은 나비가 날아와 어둠의 장막처럼: (As Ellone finishes, a black butterfly flies in from nowhere, turns into a veil of darkness, and swallows her.)
strings.(이내 그대로 하늘로 솟아올라 흔적도 없이 사라진다.): (It rises into the sky and vanishes without a trace.)
...I suppose getting through without a fight was never likely.
strings.(모두가 사라진 자리, 가도의 다리 밑에서 무언가가 검은 날개를 펄럭이며: (After everyone leaves, something rises from beneath the road's bridge, beating black wings.)
strings.(그리고는 주위를 천천히 살펴보며 미소 짓는다.): (She slowly surveys the surroundings and smiles.)
strings.마음에 들어. 불완전한 존재가 만든 무대치고는 괜찮은 것 같아…. 그때나: I like it. Not bad for a stage made by an incomplete being... Then or now...
Though nothing satisfies me quite as much as you.
strings.(벨리알이 거울을 어루만지자 어딘가로 가고 있던 바르바토스의 모습이 비친: (Belial strokes her mirror. Barbatos appears in it, on his way somewhere.)
strings.(그 순간, 거울 속 바르바토스의 시선이 벨리알과 마주친다. 남자는 조소: (His gaze meets hers through the mirror. He sneers and aims his pistol.)
strings.(벨리알이 거울을 뚫고 나와 얼굴을 스치는 총탄을 움켜쥐고는 바닥에 떨어: (Belial catches the bullet that passes through the mirror and grazes her face, then drops it to the ground.)
strings.곧 무너질 당신의 모습을 보러 갈게. 기다려. 그 누구의 것도 아닌 나만: I'll come watch you crumble soon. Wait for me. My Kaulini, belonging to no one else...
strings.(힐다의 손 끝에서 흘러내린 피가 날카로운 식물 줄기 끝에 닿자 줄기의: (Blood from Hilda's fingertip touches a sharp plant stem. It stops moving, then rapidly burrows into the ground and disappears.)
strings.후우, 이걸로 끝…. 아리엘, 괜찮지?: Whew. Done... Ariel, you're all right?
strings.저기, 힐다…. 신탁에 개입할 건가요?: Hilda... Are you going to interfere with the oracle?
I thought you were just an incompetent angel, but surprisingly...
strings.그야 천사니까요. 그리고 무능한 게 아니라 일이 적성에 맞지 않는 것뿐이: Well, I am an angel. And I'm not incompetent. The job simply doesn't suit me. Oh, %s is coming.
strings.괜찮으신가요? 엘로네는 어떻게 됐죠?: Are you? What happened to Ellone?
She told me to find her in the River of Hatred and Oaths, then disappeared.
strings.결국 가셔야겠군요. 신탁을 거스를 수는 없으니까요. 그랬다간 더 위험해질: Then you'll have to go. You can't defy the oracle. That could make things more dangerous...
Hilda, you mustn't go to the river.
It's called the River of Hatred and Oaths now, but in truth it's the river of death.
strings.수명이 다해 머물 육체가 없는 영혼이 강물에 몸을 맡긴 채로 안식의 시간: Souls whose lives have ended and who have no bodies left surrender to its waters. After a time of rest, they're sent into the world again.
strings.그 과정에서 이전의 기억을 잃고요…. 이건 신조차 거스를 수 없는 법칙이: They lose their former memories in the process... A law even gods cannot defy...
strings.지금 누군가가 두 사람의 영혼을 보호하는 주문을 걸어 준 것 같은데, 같: Someone seems to have cast a spell protecting your two souls. But going together would be dangerous.
strings.높은 확률로 둘 중 하나는 죽어서 온 영혼으로 인식될 수 있거든요. 그러: There's a high chance one of you would be recognized as a soul of the dead. You'd unknowingly jump into the river to undergo purification.
The rules of the ordinary world don't apply there...
Not time yet, perhaps...? Sorry, %s. Go alone this time.
It's all right. Nothing to apologize for.
strings.그런데 엘로네는 어떻게 거기에 있는 거야?: Then how can Ellone be there?
strings.죽음의 강은 지금도 제 역할을 하면서 흐르고 있지만, 일부 구역에는 카울: The river still fulfills its role, but Kaulini's will reaches part of it.
strings.10년 전에 많은 영혼을 꺼내 살렸고, 최근에는 엘로네도 되살렸죠. 그래: He pulled out many souls and revived them ten years ago, and recently revived Ellone, too. That's why she can go to the riverbank.
strings.그렇군요. 한 가지 더 궁금한 게 있어요. 왜 '증오와 맹세의 강'이라고: I see. One more thing. Why is it called the River of Hatred and Oaths?
strings.오래전 카울리니가 자신을 타락시킨 신을 '증오'하면서 그들을 심판하겠다고: Long ago, Kaulini hated the gods who caused his fall and swore to judge them... Right there...
There may be more, but that's all I know.
You certainly know a lot, Ariel.
strings.그야 천사니까요…. 아, 계속 힐다에게 말리네요. 저는 그냥 조용히 일했: Well, I'm an angel... Oh, you keep drawing me in, Hilda. I just did my work quietly...
Thank you, Ariel. So I take the path ahead...
strings.(아리엘이 조용히 %s의 손을 붙잡고는 손등에 가볍게 키스한다.): (Ariel quietly takes %s's hand and lightly kisses its back.)
...I-I worked up the courage to give you an angel's greeting...
Oh... Like the battle angels' kisses on the cheek. Thank you, Ariel.
strings.자, 두 분, 제가 아는 건 전부 말씀드렸으니까 절 못 본 척 지나가 주: Now, I've told you everything I know. Please pretend you never saw me. I'll go home and quietly do nothing.
Ariel, I'll be back. We'll talk afterward. Sorry.
Your souls are alike, and you're equally annoying. Sigh. Fine...
Let's go. The River of Hatred and Oaths... The river of death...
strings.(보랏빛으로 물든 하늘과 땅, 그리고 끝없이 펼쳐진 강. 그 위로 녹아내: (Violet sky and land, an endless river, and moonlight flowing like melted silver capture the adventurer's gaze.)
strings.(한 발짝 내디딜 때마다 발밑의 꽃밭에서 흘러나오는 향이 코끝을 자극한다: (With each step, fragrance rises from the flowers underfoot and brushes their nose.)
I never imagined a place like this...
strings.그에게는 다가가지도 못한 채 이곳에서 영혼의 소멸을 맞이하고 싶으신 건: Surely you don't intend to let your soul perish here without even reaching him...
strings.(다가오는 램프 불빛에 놀란 모험가가 주위를 둘러보며 뒤로 물러난다.): (Startled by the approaching lamplight, the adventurer looks around and steps back.)
Fall that way and you'll lose your memories. Wait a moment.
strings.(엘로네가 램프를 들어 주변을 비추자 %s의 발밑에 있던 물이 흩어지듯: (Ellone lifts her lamp to illuminate the surroundings. The water around %s's feet disperses and disappears.)
strings.(내가 언제 물 속으로 들어왔지…?): (When did I walk into the water...?)
Slowly. Come up along the path between the flowers.
strings.글쎄요. 저는 그저 주인의 뜻을 따를 뿐이에요 딱히 도와드린다고 생각하지: Who knows? I merely follow my master's will. I don't particularly consider it helping.
Thanks to you, I got out safely.
strings.(엘로네가 물 위로 올라온 %s의 상태를 확인하고는 등을 돌린다.): (Ellone checks %s's condition after they leave the water, then turns away.)
To the place where I should be waiting for you.
First, we must see whether you're ready... They will come now.
strings.주인께서 믿었던 이들의 손에 의해 이 강으로 끌려와 빠졌을 때…, 신이: When my master was dragged here and cast into the river by those he trusted... the worst emotions a god could harbor flowed into it, too.
The spirits here must have been thrown into confusion by those feelings.
strings.주인께서 다른 신들에게 느낀 실망과 분노가 어떤 정령에게는 그대로 전해졌: Some received his disappointment and anger toward the other gods. For others, it became the reason they had no choice but to go to the Demon Realm...
strings.(엘로네가 강 끝에 걸린 달을 향해 푸르게 타오르는 램프를 치켜든다.): (Ellone raises her blue-burning lamp toward the moon hanging over the river's end.)
strings.(엘로네의 말과 함께, 램프의 빛에 가려져 보이지 않던 정령들이 서서히: (At her words, spirits concealed by the lamp's light slowly reveal themselves.)
They will test whether you can bear... all those emotions...
strings.부디 이들을 헤치고 오길 바랄 뿐…. 그러지 못한다면 이 강물에 휩쓸려: I can only hope you make it through them... Otherwise, this river will sweep you away to somewhere unknown...
strings.(엘로네가 들고 있는 램프의 불꽃이 꺼진다. 그 순간 공간을 가득 채운: (The lamp's flame goes out. In that instant, the moonlight filling the space and Ellone's presence disappear.)
strings.(달이 다시 깨어나듯 달빛이 번져 나가는 순간, 꽃밭과 강에 서 있는 정: (As moonlight spreads once more, as though the moon awakens, every spirit among the flowers and in the river turns toward one point.)
strings.(강물에서 길 위로 올라오려는 정령들을 피해 달려가는 %s의 뒤로, 빠르: (%s runs, avoiding spirits climbing from the river onto the path. Moonlight reveals white butterflies flying swiftly after them.)
strings.(언젠가처럼 나비들이 거대한 장막처럼 모험가를 덮어 버린다. 그 사이로: (As once before, the butterflies cover the adventurer like a vast veil. Within it flickers the blue light of what seems to be Ellone's lamp.)
strings.(엘로네의 램프 속 불꽃이 하얀 장막을 태우자 달빛이 녹아내리듯 흐르는: (The flame burns away the white veil, revealing the violet river with moonlight flowing over it once more.)
strings.정령들이 물러나도록 한 거야?: Did you make the spirits retreat?
strings.그들은 그 자리에 있어요. 다만 우리가 다른 곳에 있을 뿐이죠. 어쨌든: They remain where they were. We are simply somewhere else. In any case, I've seen your resolve.
Now you will see the resolve of Ellone, the spirit who follows her master's will.
strings.(엘로네의 손에 들려 있는 램프 속 불꽃이 점점 활활 타오른다.): (The flame in Ellone's lamp burns ever more fiercely.)
...I will never repeat the mistake of falling to a demon's touch.
strings.(이어 다른 손에 들린 얼음 검 또한 강력한 한기를 내뿜는다.): (The ice sword in her other hand releases an intense chill.)
(Ugh. Different from Lauma and Giltine in the mirror. Stronger than before...)
Let us begin. I will be different from that wretched self within the mirror.
strings.(얼음 검의 날이 커다란 소리와 함께 바닥으로 떨어지고, 램프에서 흐르는: (The ice blade falls to the ground with a great crash. The blue flame flowing from the lamp stops burning and evaporates.)
strings.벨리알과 호각으로 싸운 당신의 실력을 의심해서 미안해요…. 당신의 각오가: I'm sorry I doubted the skill of someone who fought Belial as an equal... Your resolve exceeds mine. So this is the result.
Now open the way to Amaranth Nova.
Without me, you can neither meet him nor save Linford...
After I send you alone to him...
strings.(그때 엘로네와 %s 앞으로 어디선가 본 듯한 커다란 거울이 하나 나타나: (A familiar-looking great mirror appears before Ellone and %s. A woman slowly steps out.)
No wonder I couldn't reach Kaulini.
strings.엘로네, 저 인간 대신 날 그가 있는 곳으로 보내 줘. 하나만 보낼 수: Ellone, send me to him instead of that human. You said only one can go.
strings.(벨리알이 움직이지 못하는 모험가를 향해 살며시 미소 짓고는, 엘로네를: (Belial smiles softly at the motionless adventurer, then strokes her mirror while looking at Ellone.)
Ellone, now. I don't repeat myself.
As a demon, you've already repeated dozens, hundreds of lies.
strings.내 심기를 건드리지 마. 그의 손으로 다시 살아났다고 해도 넌 내겐 그저: Don't test my patience. Even revived by his hand, you're only a worthless spirit to me...
strings.날 거역한다면 어떻게 되는지 알고 있잖아. 지금 %s의 상태보다 더한 고: You know what happens if you defy me. You'll suffer worse than %s is now.
strings.그를 처음으로 보러가는 건 네가 아닌 내가 될 거야. %s, 이대로 남은: I will see him first, not you. %s, enjoy what time you have left. There are plenty of spirits to play with you in this river without Ellone.
Lady Belial, take my hand. I'll lead you there.
strings.(벨리알이 엘로네의 손을 잡는 순간, 바닥에서 검고 굵은 식물 줄기가 올: (As Belial takes Ellone's hand, thick black vines rise from the ground and bind their hands together.)
strings.허튼 수를 쓰다니. 겨우 이런 것으로 날 묶어 둘 수 있을 거라 생각해?: A foolish trick. Do you think something this feeble can hold me?
strings.(곧이어 다른 방향에서 굵은 식물 줄기가 올라와 벨리알의 다리와 팔을 옭: (More thick vines rise from another direction, binding Belial's arms and legs so she cannot move.)
strings.(그 말과 함께 엘로네와 벨리알이 서 있는 자리가 순식간에 절벽 끝처럼: (The place beneath Ellone and Belial instantly changes into the edge of a cliff.)
strings.잠깐, 엘로네. 뭘 어떻게 하려고…?: Wait, Ellone. What are you planning...?
strings.우습구나, 엘로네. 여기서 이렇게 발악을 하다니. 당장 그만두는 게 어때: Ridiculous, Ellone. Struggling like this. Why not stop now? How will you face the consequences? Mmph? Mmmph!
strings.(엘로네가 벨리알에게 다가가 손으로 입을 막아 버리자 굵은 줄기가 둘을: (Ellone approaches and covers Belial's mouth. Thick vines wrap around them both.)
strings.벨리알, 당신은 내게 너무 많은 거짓말을 했어…. 그에 반해 난 이제 겨: Belial, you told me so many lies... I've told only one. Is that too much?
strings.벨리알, 난 당신과 황혼의 기억을 지우고 더는 깨어나지 못할 세계로 갈: I'll erase the memories of you and the Twilight, and go to a world where I'll never awaken.
Then that person can go meet him.
strings.(엘로네가 벨리알을 붙잡은 채 절벽 밑으로 흐르는 강을 바라본다.): (Holding Belial, Ellone looks at the river flowing beneath the cliff.)
To make my complete annihilation the condition for opening Amaranth Nova...
If this is your will, and this will earn forgiveness for my sin back then...
strings.(그 순간, 보라색 달빛을 맞은 강물이 찰랑이면서 작은 물방울들이 엘로네: (The river ripples beneath violet moonlight, and small droplets leap toward Ellone.)
strings.(하얀 나비가 %s의 머리 위로 날아와 앉는 순간, 온통 하얗던 시야가: (A white butterfly lands on %s's head. Their entirely white vision returns to normal.)
I followed Ellone, then met Belial, and Ellone...
strings.(조금 전까지 엘로네가 서 있던 자리에 굵은 식물 가지가 잘려 나간 듯한: (Where Ellone stood moments ago remain marks like severed thick branches.)
strings.엘로네에게는 아마란스 노바로 가기 위한 어떤 선택도 결국 죽음이었던 건가: For Ellone, did every choice that opened Amaranth Nova lead to death...?
strings.(%s의 머리에 앉아 있던 작은 하얀 나비가 천천히 앞으로 날아갔다가 다: (The little white butterfly on %s's head slowly flies forward, then returns, again and again.)
strings.(저쪽으로 가라는 것처럼 움직이네….): (As though it's telling me to go that way...)
strings.(나비가 날아가는 곳으로 발걸음을 옮기자, 이번에는 돌아오지 않은 채 앞: (As I step toward it, the butterfly stops returning and flies straight ahead.)
strings.(멀리 린포드 풍경이 보이는 것 같기도 하고…. 밖으로 나갈 수 있게 된: (I think I can see Linford in the distance... It seems I can leave now...)
strings.(이제 아마란스 노바로 갈 수 있는 걸까? 바르바토스는 그곳에서 뭐 하는: (Can I enter Amaranth Nova now? What's Barbatos doing there...?)
strings.(하아, 일단 나가서 확인해 보는 수밖에….): (Sigh. I'll have to get out and find out...)
strings.(벨리알이 힘겨운 표정을 지으며 강물 속에서 천천히 기어 나온다.): (With a pained expression, Belial slowly crawls from the river.)
strings.소멸의 감정이 이런 기분이었다니…. 하아, 내가 이런 기분을 느낄 줄이야: So this is what annihilation feels like... Ah, to think I'd feel this... I've only ever deceived those who were dying...
strings.뭔가 짜릿한걸. 하아, 카울리니…. 대체 아마란스 노바에 뭘 숨기셨을까?: Rather thrilling. Ah, Kaulini... What are you hiding in Amaranth Nova?
strings.(벨리알이 입술에 묻은 피를 닦으며 자리에서 일어난다. 손 끝으로 원을: (Belial wipes blood from her lips and stands. She traces a circle with a fingertip, and a large mirror appears.)
strings.(천천히 거울 안으로 들어가려던 벨리알이 발걸음을 멈추고 거울에 비치는: (About to enter, she stops and looks at the moon reflected in it.)
strings.카울리니, 여기서도 날 보고 있겠지?: Kaulini, you're watching me here, too, aren't you?
strings.재미있는 순간은 지금뿐일 거야. 조금만 즐기도록 해. 이제 당신의 모든: Enjoy this amusing moment while it lasts. I'm coming to deceive everything you are.
strings.(눈앞에 보이는 린포드가 심각하게 흔들리자 놀란 아리엘이 서둘러 힐다의: (As Linford shakes violently before them, the startled Ariel hastily grabs Hilda's hand.)
strings.(작은 날개로 힘겹게 날아오르려다가 그대로 바닥에 떨어지고 만다.): (She struggles to rise on her little wings, but falls to the ground.)
...We need to flee... Otherwise, like last time...
I couldn't save them... I couldn't...
strings.그렇다고 해도…. 어? 언제 흔들림이 멈췄죠?: Even so... Oh? When did the shaking stop?
strings.아까 몇 초 정도 그러다가 멈춘 것 같아. 다시 흔들릴 징조는 없어 보여: It shook for a few seconds, then stopped. No sign of it starting again.
strings.(아리엘이 다시 날갯짓을 하며 허공으로 떠오른다.): (Ariel flaps her wings again and rises into the air.)
strings.뭐야? 아까는 왜 떨어졌는데?: What? Why did you fall earlier?
strings.날개가 점점 퇴화해서 다른 사람을 데리고 오르기는 역시 무리였어요. 그런: My wings have been degenerating. Carrying someone else was too much. But over there... Amaranth Nova...
strings.그야 천사니까요. 어, 언제 오셨어요?: Well, I'm an angel. Oh, when did you arrive?
strings.몰골이 이게 뭐야…. 괜찮아?: You look awful... Are you all right?
strings.그럭저럭 괜찮아. 그런데 아마란스 노바에 무슨 일이 있나요?: More or less. What's happening with Amaranth Nova?
strings.…이제는 접근할 수 있는 것 같아요. 전에는 다가가면 강한 마력 때문에: ...It seems we can approach now. Before, powerful magic forced me backward. Now it feels weaker.
strings.(아리엘과 힐다에게 증오와 맹세의 강에서 일어난 일을 이야기한다.): (I tell Ariel and Hilda what happened at the River of Hatred and Oaths.)
If Ellone fell into the river of death with Belial, she must already be gone. But there's one part I find hard to believe...
Kaulini using a spirit he cherished like that... Something's wrong.
Tell us if you have an idea.
strings.자세히는 모르지만, 예전의 카울리니와는 뭔가가 다른 것 같아요…. 미안해: I don't know the details, but something seems different from the old Kaulini... I'm sorry. That's all I can say.
strings.그런데 아리엘, 하나 궁금한 게 있는데… 어떻게 카울리니를 그렇게 잘 알: Ariel, I've been wondering... How do you know Kaulini so well?
strings.천사의 일을 하지 않고 도망간 건 나중에 이리스에게 정상 참작해 달라고: I'll ask Iris to consider your circumstances when it comes to abandoning your angelic duties.
Oh, I blew it... No choice. I'll just tell you.
strings.예전에 제가 모시던 신께서 기만의 악마를 심판하러 가겠다고 하셨다가 돌아: Long ago, the god I served went to judge the demon of deceit and never returned...
strings.남은 정령들과 천사들은 여러 신에게 맡겨졌는데, 저는 카울리니 님께 맡겨: The remaining spirits and angels were entrusted to various gods. I was given to Kaulini. I ran errands and came to know Ellone...
strings.그때 기만의 악마가 벨리알이라는 사실을 알게 됐어요. 많은 신과 정령,: That's when I learned the demon of deceit was Belial. She'd corrupted many gods, spirits, and living beings...
Then one day, while I was briefly away on an errand, the Beast appeared...
Has she appeared again? Let's go toward the sound.
I'll watch Amaranth Nova in the meantime...
All right. Please do. Come on, Hilda.
strings.(거울 깨지는 소리가 계속 들려오고, 두 사람은 그 소리를 쫓아 아이테르: (The sound of breaking mirrors continues. They follow it along Aether Road, wandering until they stop at a certain point.)
No one's here. I could have sworn the sound came from nearby...
I met Ellone here before entering the River of Hatred and Oaths.
strings.(그 순간 어디선가 짙은 어둠이 몰려와 두 사람이 서 있는 공간을 가득: (Deep darkness rushes in from somewhere and fills the space around them.)
strings.(어둠 속에서 어디선가 본 듯한 인물이 떠올라 강물처럼 일렁이며 흐르기: (A familiar-looking figure emerges within it, rippling and flowing like a river.)
strings.내가 목격했다. 같이 있던 동료가 순식간에 소멸한 모습을 봤다고!! 순식: I witnessed it. I saw my companion vanish in an instant! Dead in an instant!
strings.그건 이곳에 있는 우리를 포함해 이 세계를 지우려 했다. 왜 믿지 않지?: It intended to erase this world, including all of us here. Why won't you believe me?
strings.이 별에는 생명에게 '신'이라 불리는 우리보다 강한 존재가 있을 수 없다: You say nothing on this star can be stronger than us, whom living beings call gods?
strings.그러면 심연에서 태어난 마계는 무엇이라 설명할 것이냐…. 우리가 모르는: Then how do you explain the Demon Realm born from the abyss...? You refuse to admit there may be worlds we do not know.
strings.오만한 자들…. 정신 차려라…. 우리가 힘을 합치면 그 괴물을 쓰러뜨릴: Arrogant fools... Wake up... Together, we can defeat that monster.
strings.우리의 세계를 지킬 수 있다고…. 심연에서 끌어온 힘으로 별을 만들어 괴: We can protect our world... Create a star with power drawn from the abyss and drop it on the monster...
Why are you attacking me? I am not your enemy.
strings.왜 내 입을 막으려 하느냐!! 왜 날 인간으로 만들어 죽이려 하느냐!!: Why silence me?! Why make me human and try to kill me?!
To kill me... You destroyed that innocent village in the clouds...
Is this your answer? Is this truly what you want...?
Insects who will not make even the slightest effort...
strings.날 이렇게 만들면 그걸로 끝인 줄 알았겠지…. 디어사이드가 되어 돌아올: You thought making me like this would end it... You never expected me to return as a Deicide...
strings.얼마나 더 베어야 다시 돌아갈 수 있는지 말해라. 모르겠다니…. 후우,: Tell me how many more I must cut down to return. You don't know...? Sigh. I bear you no grudge, but die for me.
For you, falling into the Demon Realm with despair, this name will suit you.
strings.당신이 다시 깨어날 날을 기대하고 있을게. 그동안 당신은 조용히 마계에서: I'll look forward to the day you awaken again. Until then, spend your time quietly in the Demon Realm...
strings.(벨리알의 환영이 다가온 순간, 어디선가 거울 깨지는 소리가 커다랗게 들: (As Belial's illusion approaches, a loud sound of shattering mirrors comes from somewhere.)
strings.(거울 깨지는 소리를 듣는 순간, 크게 충격을 받은 듯이 눈이 번쩍 뜨인: (At the sound, my eyes fly open as though struck by a great shock.)
...It's the same as before. As though someone is deliberately showing us this.
Is Belial showing it to us...?
I don't think it's Belial... Could it be Daphne...?
No, surely not. There's no one here but us...
strings.다프네를 과소평가하지 마. 그를 겪고도 그런 소리가 나오네. %s, 그런: Don't underestimate Daphne. How can you say that after everything you've experienced? %s, what's this stuck to you? It looks like a spore...
strings.(힐다가 %s의 등 뒤에 붙어 있는 것을 떼 주는 순간, 무언가가 깨지는: (Hilda removes something from %s's back, and a shattering sound rings out.)
strings.어디서 들리는 거지? 가도를 그렇게 헤맸는데도 거울 같은 건 보이지 않았: Where is that coming from? We wandered all over the highway without seeing any mirrors...
strings.(그때, 멀리 보이는 린포드의 형상 위로 벨리알의 것으로 보이는 거울 여: (Several of Belial's mirrors rise above distant Linford, then shatter all at once.)
strings.%s, 저길 봐!! 사람들이 있는 곳에서 거울이 깨지고 있어!!: %s, look over there!! Mirrors are shattering where the people are!!
strings.힐다, 가자. 사람들이 위험해!! 빨리 마을로 가자!!: Come on, Hilda. They're in danger!! We have to get back to the village!!
strings.(린포드로 돌아온 두 사람의 앞으로 어디선가 본 적이 있는 듯한 마족과: (As we return, familiar demons and beasts fly past us and crash into buildings.)
Caluso, you're supposed to say that before you throw the punch.
strings.리디아 님? 언제 오셨어요?: Lydia? When did you get here?
strings.이제 막 도착했어. 어떻게 하다 보니 아이테르 가도를 거치지 않고 바로: Just now. Somehow, we managed to reach Linford directly without passing through Aether Road.
We don't have time for a long explanation, so I'll keep this brief.
strings.칼루소 아저씨와 내가 마족들을 상대하면서 시간을 벌 동안 여기 아스크렌: While Caluso and I hold off the demons, Father Askren here will... Father? Where did he go?
strings.살려 주세요, 선배님!! 마족들이 쫓아와요오오오오!!: Save me, senior!! The demons are chasing meeee!!
strings.은근 손 많이 가는 친구군. 전투 능력이 프리링 정도일 줄이야…. 리디아: He needs more looking after than you'd think. I didn't expect his combat ability to be on a Priring's level... Lydia, I'll get him.
strings.알겠어, 칼루소 아저씨. 미안. 아스크렌 사제 때문에…. 어쨌든 사제가: All right, Caluso. Sorry about Father Askren... Anyway, he'll put up a barrier to protect Linford.
strings.허당처럼 보여도 실력 하나는 확실하거든. 이카로스의 날개가 추락할 때 이: He may seem hopeless, but his abilities are the real thing. You've already seen that when the Wings of Icarus was falling, remember?
He got that enormous airship into the space on the other side.
strings.고대 엘프의 비술을 효과적으로 다룰 수 있는 인재야. 그래서 여기저기 부: He's gifted at using the ancient elves' secret arts. That's why he's in demand everywhere. He says he might reach the fourth rank soon, though we'll see...
strings.…어쨌든 아마란스 노바에서 무슨 일이 일어날지 알 수 없지만, 그 여파로: ...Anyway, we don't know what will happen in Amaranth Nova, but the consequences could endanger Linford...
And then the demon Belial showed up, scattered mirrors around, and vanished...
strings.%s, 힐다. 두 사람은 아마란스 노바로 들어가. 우리는 여기서 마족들을: %s, Hilda. You two go into Amaranth Nova. We'll fight the demons here and prepare for whatever happens.
strings.그런 건 뭐… 신경 쓰지 마. 어쨌든 잘 부탁해. 빨리 아마란스 노바로: Oh, don't worry about that. Anyway, we're counting on you. Hurry to Amaranth Nova.
All right. Please take care of Linford.
Roro, go put some power into Caluso's fists.
Phew, you saved me. Just two more places to check now.
strings.아스크렌 사제, 잘했어. 마족들이 겁먹었으니까 그 틈을 타서 뛰라고!: Well done, Father Askren. The demons are scared, so run while you have the chance!
strings.칼루소 아저씨, 일단 마을 사람들은 전부 대피시켰어. 다행히 다친 사람은: Caluso, all the villagers have been evacuated. Luckily, it looks like no one's hurt.
strings.무슨 말 하려는지 알아. 하지만 지금은 아스크렌 사제가 집중해야 하고,: I know what you're going to say. But right now Father Askren needs to concentrate, and we have to help see the oracle through.
strings.성스러움과 사악함이 교차하는 장소가 천계의 조각에 있다니…. 여기는 대체: A place where the holy and the wicked intersect, within a fragment of the Celestial Realm... What is this place...?
strings.아스크렌 사제, 정신 차려!! 머릿속으로 들어오는 기억들의 감정을 느끼지: Father Askren, stay with us!! Don't let yourself feel the emotions of the memories entering your mind!!
Roro, draw out the rage inside me... I need to end this in one stroke...
strings.(아리엘이 마수를 피해 도망가다가 그만 넘어지고 만다.): (Ariel flees a beast, then trips and falls.)
An angel like me wouldn't even taste good...
strings.(그때 마수가 강한 충격을 맞고 멀리 날아가 버린다.): (The beast is sent flying into the distance.)
Th-thank you, Hailey... I'll be going, then...
strings.어디 가려고, 천사님?: Where are you going, little angel?
I can see those beautiful wings you had back then...
strings.저곳을 가로막고 있던 뭔가가 사라진 것 같은데…. 맞지?: It looks like whatever was blocking that place is gone... Am I right?
strings.(헤일리가 아마란스 노바 방향으로 다가가려는 순간, 아리엘이 붙잡아 당긴: (As Hailey approaches Amaranth Nova, Ariel pulls her back.)
You can't. An ordinary human or elf could be annihilated just by approaching it.
strings.나는 다른 엘프보다 수백 년은 더 산 하이엘프인데도?: Even a high elf who's lived centuries longer than other elves?
strings.헤일리. 여기 있었어요? 아리엘, 괜찮아요?: Hailey. You were here? Ariel, are you all right?
strings.다행이군. 그런데 헤일리, 뭐 하는 거야? 다 알게 된 거야?: That's good. But Hailey, what are you doing? Have you found out everything?
Oh! Sorry. They looked so soft, I reached out without thinking.
It's all right. I suppose I can't hide them anymore...
strings.아무래도 아마란스 노바로 갈 수 있게 되면서 그 안에 있는 신성한 힘의: Now that Amaranth Nova is accessible, I think its holy power is affecting me.
strings.아, 지금 마을은 괜찮나요?: Oh, is the village all right?
Demigods and priests from the Order are fighting the beasts and demons. It looks like the villagers have already evacuated...
strings.…교단의 데미갓과 사제들이 왔다니 그나마 다행이긴 한데…. 저 거울의 주: ...It's a relief that the Order's Demigods and priests are here... Tell me the name of the demon who owns those mirrors.
strings.헤일리, 여기서 아리엘과 함께 마수들을 정리해 줘요. 우리는 저곳에서 해: Hailey, please help Ariel take care of the beasts here. We have something to do in there.
strings.그리고 아리엘, 도와줘서 고마웠어요. 이리스에게 알리겠다는 건 그냥 해: And Ariel, thank you for helping. I didn't mean it when I said I'd tell Iris.
strings.…아니에요. 괜찮아요. 저기… 아마란스 노바에 한번 들어가시면 일이 해결: ...No, it's all right. Um... Once you enter Amaranth Nova, you won't be able to leave until this is resolved.
It won't be an easy path, but please come back safely...
strings.(모험가와 힐다가 아마란스 노바를 향해 뛰어가자, 기다리고 있었다는 듯: (As Hilda and I run toward Amaranth Nova, demons and beasts swarm out of the highway as though they have been waiting.)
strings.아리엘, 혹시 회복 마법 같은 것 쓸 수 있어?: Ariel, can you use healing magic or anything like that?
It isn't magic, but I can do something similar.
strings.좋아. 그러면… 내가 요청할 때 걸어 줘…. 지금 내가 눈앞에 있는 것들: Good. Then... use it when I ask. I'm going to clear away everything in front of us.
strings.(심연에서 깨어난 별이 추락하면서 만든 도시의 구멍. 모험가와 힐다가 그: (The star's fall from the abyss left a hole in the city. Hilda and I run carefully, taking care not to fall.)
strings.멀리서 본 것보다 훨씬 처참하네…. 게다가 이 숨 막히는 기운은 뭐지?: It's far worse than it looked from a distance... And what is this suffocating presence?
strings.천계의 조각에서는 제대로 느낄 수 없던 천계의 기운이야. 이제야 신의 영: It's the power of the Celestial Realm, something we couldn't properly sense in its fragment. Now it really feels like we're in the domain of a god.
strings.이건… 그가 가진 기운이야. %s, 뒤로 물러나. 어서!: This is... his presence. %s, get back. Now!
strings.(그때 어디선가 검은 나비가 날아와 두 사람 앞에서 펼쳐지며 한 사람의: (A black butterfly flies in and spreads into the silhouette of a man.)
strings.기다리고 있었습니다, %s. 그 이름으로 불리는 것도 오늘이 마지막일지: I've been waiting, %s. Today may be the last time anyone calls me by that name.
Hilda is here too. I was hoping you would come alone, %s... How disappointing.
strings.하하, 아무래도 상관없는 것이군요. 알겠습니다. 어쨌든 절 만났으니 두: Ha ha. It doesn't matter either way, then. Very well. Now that you've met me, neither of you is likely to leave alive.
strings.칭찬입니까? 뭐, 됐습니다. 이 자리에 여신과 모험가가 함께 오길 바랐는: Is that a compliment? Never mind. I had hoped the goddess and the adventurer would come here together. A pity.
strings.경멸의 감정을 가득 담은 그 눈빛, 좋습니다. 그럼 여기서 끝내 드리도록: Those eyes, full of contempt. I like them. Then let me bring this to an end.
strings.(바르바토스가 검을 들어 경계하는 두 사람을 향해 든 순간, 그의 입과: (Barbatos raises his sword, but blood begins to flow from his mouth and eyes.)
strings.(흘러내리는 피를 닦지만 선명하게 눈물이 흘러 상처를 더욱 벌린다.): (He wipes away the blood, but bloody tears continue to flow as his wounds widen.)
I gathered all this power to become a god again. Why...? Cough, cough...
strings.(바르바토스가 망토로 몸을 감싸더니 서둘러 뒤돌아 뛰어가기 시작한다.): (He wraps himself in his cloak, turns, and runs.)
strings.쿨럭, 쿨럭…. %s…. 고대했던 시간은 잠깐 미루기로 할까요? 이 모습: Cough, cough... %s... Shall we postpone our long-awaited moment? It wouldn't be enjoyable with me like this...
strings.(그 말과 함께 바르바토스가 아마란스 노바 중심의 검은 구멍 안으로 몸을: (Barbatos leaps into the black hole at the center of Amaranth Nova.)
Something seems to have happened to Barbatos...
strings.쫓아가자. 그런데 여기서 어떻게 저기로 내려가지? 그냥 몸을 던지면 되나: Let's follow him. But how do we get down there? Do we just jump...?
