Stop, %s. You can't jump straight down from here. You'd be annihilated instantly. Watch.
strings.(힐다가 검은 구멍을 향해 돌을 던지자 그 자리에서 흔적도 없이 가루가: (Hilda throws a stone, and it instantly turns to dust.)
Don't forget we're in a god's domain. We have to move carefully...
strings.알겠어, 힐다…. 그런데 저 밑에는 뭐가 있는 걸까?: All right, Hilda... But what's down there?
We'll find out when we get there...
strings.(요동치는 마력을 내뿜는 검은 구멍을 타고 내려오자 폐허가 된 신전의 모: (We descend into the black hole through surging magical power and find a ruined temple. After wandering through it, we spot a dark figure.)
strings.저기 바르바토스가 있어, 힐다. 힐다? 괜찮아?: There's Barbatos, Hilda. Hilda? Are you all right?
strings.(기척을 느낀 바르바토스가 입과 눈에 흐르는 붉은 피를 닦아 내고서 천천: (Sensing us, Barbatos wipes away his blood and approaches.)
strings.(신성한 신과는 거리가 먼, 더욱 어둡고 검게 변한 마족 '절망의 대공': (The Grand Duke of Despair, darker than before and far from the image of a holy god, sneers at us.)
strings.기다리고 있었습니다. 어쩌다 보니 이곳에서 맞이하게 되는군요. 비록 제가: I've been waiting. As it turns out, I will be welcoming you here. It isn't the situation I wanted...
strings.…두 사람의 영혼을 거두는 데는 아무런 문제가 없습니다. 그러니 시작에: ...But it will not prevent me from claiming your souls. Before we begin, there is something I must tell you.
strings.무슨 이야기를 하려고?: What are you going to tell us?
strings.(바르바토스가 눈을 감자 그의 주위로 강력한 마력의 장벽이 솟아오르고,: (He closes his eyes, and a barrier of magical power rises. Beyond a pillar, a statue shaped like a person comes into view.)
strings.(수, 숨 막혀…. 저건 또 뭐지…?): (I... I can barely breathe... What is that...?)
strings.옛날, 아주 먼 옛날 신과 모든 생명을 잡아먹으려던 괴물을 쓰러뜨릴 유일: Long ago, in the distant past, there was only one means of defeating the monster that sought to devour the gods and all life.
strings.(그의 말과 함께 마력 장벽 너머로 고대의 풍경이 흐르듯 펼쳐진다.): (Scenes of the ancient past flow beyond the magical barrier.)
strings.…그 괴물은 지금 성계신이 인간일 때 쓰러뜨렸겠지만, 그때는 그것뿐이었죠: ...The one who is now the God of the Astral Realm may have defeated that monster as a human, but at the time, it was our only means.
The gods of that time did not fight. Only a select few shared a certain 'secret'...
strings.그 비밀은 절대자에 의해 이 별이 소멸할 것이란 사실. 당신이 알고 있는: The secret was that the Absolute would destroy this planet. Perhaps he is the old man you know.
strings.이 세계를 만들고 생명을 사랑한다 말했던 이들이 정작 생명을 지키지 않고: Those who had created this world and claimed to love life were preparing to flee to another world, without protecting the lives here...
Part of that process was hidden behind the name 'Twilight.'
strings.레테는 추방당하고, 헤카테는 영원의 시간 속에 갇혔으며…. 나머지는 당신: Lethe was exiled, and Hecate was imprisoned in an eternity of time... You know the rest...
I can only pity the gods who died knowing nothing...
strings.그들은 저 또한 인간으로 만들어 죽이려 했지만 한 가지 사실을 간과했습니: They tried to make me human and kill me too, but they overlooked one fact. I, too, was born a god.
strings.어쨌든, 제 기억을 벨리알이 건드리면서 다가온 고통 때문에 심연에 저와: In any case, the pain brought on by Belial tampering with my memories reminded me of the star that fell into the abyss with me, and I came here.
Because their grave lay here, beneath Linford...
strings.소중한 생명을 지키지 못했음을 후회하며 다시는 잃지 않겠다고 다짐했던 것: I seem to remember regretting my failure to protect precious lives, and vowing never to lose them again...
Why can I no longer recall that feeling...?
(He closes his eyes, and a powerful vortex of magical energy rises.)
strings.(지, 지금까지 느꼈던 힘과는 차원이 달라. 뭐, 뭐야…. 마치 이건……: (Th-this is on a completely different level from any power I've felt before. What... It's almost like...)
strings.(데미우르고스 때와 비슷한…. 아니, 그보다 더해…. 어?): (It's like Demiurgos... No, even greater... Hm?)
strings.(바르바토스가 다시 눈을 뜨더니 마력을 모아 건블레이드에 집중시켜 한 방: (Barbatos opens his eyes, concentrates his power in his gunblade, and fires in one direction.)
A mere demon dares to interfere with this moment...
strings.(바르바토스가 만족스러운 표정을 지으며 힐다와 시선을 마주친다.): (He looks satisfied, then turns his gaze to Hilda.)
strings.힐다, 스스로를 상처 입힐 각오가 됐군요. 하지만 지금은 물러나는 편이: Hilda, you're prepared to wound yourself. But why not step back for now?
strings.지금 이 순간은 저와 %s의 시간…. 지금 여기서 당신이 피를 흘린다면: This moment belongs to %s and me... If you spill blood here, Ouroboros will appear and ruin everything.
It would do nothing to help the current goddess, either.
Hilda, stand back. I'll handle this. Don't worry.
strings.(힐다가 고개를 숙이고는 물러서자 바르바토스의 얼굴이 일그러진다.): (Hilda lowers her head and steps back. Barbatos's expression twists.)
strings.당신의 그 모습을 보고 있자니 불쾌합니다. 스스로는 어떻게 되어도 상관없: Seeing you like this disgusts me. Does it not matter what happens to you?!
strings.다른 이를 위해서 디어사이드가 되어도? 여신을 위해 자기 자신을 잃어도?: Even if you become a Deicide for someone else? Even if you lose yourself for the goddess?
My answer hasn't changed since then. I've already made my choice, so don't ask me again.
strings.한때는 저도 당신 같은 감정으로 세상을 대했습니다. 하지만 절망의 감정을: I once faced the world with feelings like yours. But despair dragged me into the mire of the abyss...
Now I will show you the end, adventurer of the goddess...
strings.(바르바토스의 말과 함께 어디선가 금화 하나가 떠올라 손에 내려앉는다.): (A gold coin appears and lands in his hand.)
strings.나를 죽이려고 했던 자들의 힘은 내 것이 되었다…: The power of those who tried to kill me has become mine...
strings.나는 네가 사랑하는 나약한 여신을 죽여 다른 신들처럼 이 관 안에 가두고: I will kill the feeble goddess you love and seal her in this coffin with the other gods...
strings.세상의 모든 영혼과 그 영혼이 사랑하는 것들의 주인이 되어 이 세계를 다: I will become the master of every soul and everything those souls love, and rule this world.
Even if I am a demon god, unworthy of holiness...
strings.(금화가 바르바토스의 손에서 튀어 올라 허공에서 멈춘다.): (The coin leaps up and stops in midair.)
strings.그대가 지키고 싶은 것이 있다면, 앞으로 나아가고 싶다면 겁먹지 말고 날: If there is something you wish to protect, if you wish to move forward, cast aside your fear and kill me.
strings.(%s의 얼굴이 금화에 비치는 순간, 멈춰 있던 건블레이드의 방아쇠가 당: (%s's face is reflected in the coin as he pulls the gunblade's trigger.)
strings.「필멸자여, 지금부터 이 시간은 그대의 '절망'이다.」: 「Mortal, from this moment, your time is 'despair.'」
strings.(마신으로 변한 카울리니의 총탄이 고통에 신음하는 %s에게 연달아 날아간: (Demon God Kaulini fires bullets at %s, who groans in pain.)
strings.(카울리니의 대검이 지나간 자리에 붉은 액체가 떨어져 바닥에 고인다.): (Red liquid falls where the greatsword has passed.)
strings.(피투성이가 된 채로 힘겹게 버티는 모험가를 향해 카울리니가 총구를 겨눈: (He aims his gun at the blood-covered adventurer struggling to move.)
strings.그대와의 시간이 기대한 만큼 위대했다는 점은 인정해 주지. 다만 내게 미: I acknowledge that my time with you was as magnificent as I had hoped. You simply fell short of me.
strings.(바닥에 쓰러진 모험가의 초점 없는 눈을 확인한 카울리니가 미소를 짓는다: (Kaulini smiles at the fallen adventurer's unfocused eyes.)
strings.널 아꼈던 신들을 위해 특별히 저 안에 넣어 주지. 그들과 함께 심연의: For the sake of the gods who cherished you, I will grant you a special place in there. Dream of the abyss alongside them.
strings.(카울리니가 한 손으로 모험가를 들어 신들의 유해가 담긴 관으로 옮기려: (He lifts the adventurer toward the coffin holding the gods' remains, then notices Hilda.)
strings.신의 이름을 함부로 부르다니. 그래도 이번만은 특별히 용서해 주지. 힐다: You dare speak a god's name so carelessly. But I will forgive you this once. Hilda, return to your own time and savor this moment.
strings.모험가가 죽었으니 네 영혼도 이제 온전히 지낼 수 있을 것이다. 원한다면: Now that the adventurer is dead, your soul can exist whole again. If you wish, I can send you back to your own time.
Telling me to return to a world about to be destroyed? How cruel...
strings.(힐다가 미소 지으며 단검을 꺼내 검지 끝을 찌른다. 피가 바닥으로 흘러: (Hilda smiles and pricks her index finger with a dagger. Blood flows onto the floor and quickly seeps toward Kaulini and %s.)
strings.(카울리니가 놀라며 흘러드는 피를 막으려 하지만, 아마란스 노바의 마력과: (Kaulini tries to stop the blood, but it merges with Amaranth Nova's magical power and continues to flow.)
strings.카울리니, 처음부터 내가 개입하지 않도록 원래 있던 세계선에 던져 주다니: Kaulini, sending me back to my original worldline from the start so I couldn't interfere... Well done. How fitting for a god.
strings.나는 저주 받은 힘을 지닌 마녀. 나를 상처 입히는 대가로 회복과 재생의: I am a witch with cursed power. By wounding myself, I can use the powers of healing and regeneration in reverse...
It's fortunate the demon god paid me no mind...
strings.지금 내가 있는 곳은 곧 사라질 세계…. 어차피 사라질 것이라면 우로보로: The world I'm in will soon disappear... If it's going to vanish anyway, perhaps this is better than being swallowed by Ouroboros.
strings.(눈에 담을 수조차 없는 눈부신 빛이 공간을 가득 채우더니 커다란 폭발을: (A blinding light fills the space, followed by a huge explosion.)
strings.(주위를 둘러보던 모험가가 희미하게 웃는 바르바토스를 발견하고 급히 무기: (I look around and see Barbatos smiling, his weapon in his hand.)
I hoped it wouldn't turn into the worst possible situation, like when I was dragged into the river...
strings.(바르바토스가 지그시 입술을 깨물고 품 안에서 금화를 꺼내 건블레이드 위: (Barbatos bites his lip, takes a gold coin from inside his clothes, and flips it above his gunblade.)
(Our weapons clash with a deafening sound that fills the space. A moment's hesitation sends one of them flying upward.)
%s, to return alive and humiliate me like this...
strings.(바르바토스가 쓰러진 채 피틀 토하며 자신을 내려다보는 %s에게 비틀린: (Barbatos lies fallen, coughing blood, and gives %s a twisted smile.)
strings.바르바토스. 아니, 카울리니. 한때는 생명을 사랑하는 신이었지만, 지금은: Barbatos. No, Kaulini. You were once a god who loved life, but now you're only a demon trying to defile the world...
You must have felt wronged. But this isn't the place to unleash that rage...
Then where am I supposed to pour out these feelings?! Cough, cough.
strings.(바르바토스가 흉부에 박혀 있는 건블레이드 파편을 어루만진다.): (Barbatos touches the fragment of gunblade embedded in his chest.)
strings.그렇다면 당신이 제게 가르침을 주십시오. 이런 내가 다시 세상을 바라볼: Then teach me. Show me how someone like me can face the world again...
Barbatos, you've already spent far too long as a demon in the Demon Realm.
strings.(순간 모험가가 머리 위로 날아온 날카로운 금화를 붙잡는다.): (At that moment, the adventurer catches a sharp gold coin flying overhead.)
strings.악마의 뿔이 새겨진 문양이 앞뒤 모두에 새겨져 있는 동전…. 그럼 결론은: A coin with the same demon-horn emblem engraved on both sides... Then the outcome was decided from the start.
strings.(이리스가 모험가의 두 손을 잡고 걱정 어린 눈빛으로 바라보고 있다.): (Iris holds both of the adventurer's hands, looking on with concern.)
How are you here, Iris? And where are we...?
strings.여기는 조금 전까지 결전을 벌인 아마란스 노바 안이에요. 그리고 제가 내: We're inside Amaranth Nova, where you were fighting just a moment ago. And the oracle I gave you is fulfilled.
strings.(긴장이 풀린 모험가가 그제야 안심이 되는지 가볍게 한숨을 내쉰다.): (Only now does the tension leave the adventurer, who lets out a soft sigh of relief.)
I'm sorry for placing such a heavy burden on you...
strings.이제 우리가 있는 이 공간은 제가 위대한 벽으로 옮겨 나오지 못하게 할: I will move this space into the Great Wall, so nothing can emerge from it.
Then the time created by Kaulini will be set right as well.
strings.린포드를 가로막은 벽은 사라졌어요. 주민들도 자유롭게 왔다갔다 할 수 있: The wall around Linford is gone. The residents can come and go freely.
The souls of the residents who fell victim to Kaulini and then awakened again have returned to how they were.
strings.그래도 한 번 상처를 받았기 때문에 비슷한 일을 겪는다면 금방이라도 무너: But because they've already been wounded once, a similar experience could shatter them at any moment.
strings.주민들의 기억은 사라지지 않았고, 지금까지의 시간을 간직한 채, 앞으로도: Their memories haven't vanished. They will keep the time they've lived through and go on living as before.
I will be here to keep them from falling apart, so don't worry too much...
strings.혹시 그 물건 가지고 있나요?: Do you still have that item?
The one Lady Medea gave you in the Kali village.
Oh, this. She said it would help stop Daphne...
Oh, really? I'll have to thank her when I meet her.
strings.(이리스가 쓸쓸한 눈빛으로 손 끝에서 빛의 활 '세레스티아'를 만들어낸다: (With a lonely look in her eyes, Iris forms the bow of light, Celestia, at her fingertips. A beam from the sky circles its tip, becoming a beautiful arrow of light.)
strings.(날카롭게 응축된 빛의 화살이 앞으로 나아가며 거대한 빛의 문을 만들어: (The sharply condensed arrow flies forward, creating an enormous gate of light.)
strings.(아리엘이 마수에게 날개를 물릴까 봐 허우적대던 두 손을 내리고 주위를: (Ariel lowers the hands she had been waving to keep a beast from biting her wings and looks around.)
strings.(그때 눈이 마주친 헤일리가 발밑의 마수를 봉으로 내리친 뒤, 아마란스: (Meeting her eyes, Hailey strikes the beast at her feet with her staff, then looks toward Amaranth Nova.)
The demons and beasts that attacked are disappearing... Get up, Ariel.
strings.(그때 멀리서 빛의 원이 생성되고, 그 안에서 두 사람이 걸어 나온다.): (A circle of light forms in the distance, and two people step out.)
It looks like they finished things safely.
strings.아마란스 노바에서 다가오는 느낌은 그대로인 것 같은데…. 저기, %s 님: Amaranth Nova still feels the same... Um, who's that with %s...?
strings.아리엘, 헤일리, 괜찮아요?: Ariel, Hailey, are you all right?
We're fine. Is everything inside settled? And this is...?
strings.(헤일리가 이리스와 눈이 마주치자 놀라서 뒤로 물러나 고개를 숙인다.): (When Hailey meets Iris's eyes, she steps back in surprise and bows her head.)
...It is an honor to meet you.
strings.실례지만 누구신가요? %s 님과 함께 저기서 나오실 정도면 보통 분은 아: Excuse me, but who are you? You must be someone extraordinary to come out of there with %s...
strings.처음 뵙겠습니다, 이리스… 님? 아!: It's nice to meet you, Lady... Iris? Oh!
Aaaaaah, forgive me, my goddess. I'm sorry. When I ran away back then...
It's all right, Ariel. That's all in the past.
Just do your best from now on.
strings.아하, 그러면 되겠네요. 앞으로……?: Oh, then that settles it. From now on...?
strings.이제 린포드 건은 다 끝났나요…?: Is everything in Linford resolved now...?
strings.이리스, 여기 두 사람에게는 말해도 되겠지?: Iris, it's all right to tell these two, isn't it?
strings.(헤일리와 아리엘에게 상황이 종료된 과정을 간단하게 설명한다.): (I briefly explain to Hailey and Ariel how everything was resolved.)
strings.이제 두 분, 더는 죄책감을 가지지 않아도 돼요. 다시는 상처와 눈물을: Neither of you needs to feel guilty anymore. I will make sure no star falls again, spilling wounds and tears.
strings.(헤일리와 아리엘의 얼굴에 안도의 미소가 피어오른다.): (Relieved smiles spread across Hailey's and Ariel's faces.)
strings.지금까지 그래왔듯 앞으로도 린포드를 잘 부탁드려요. 헤일리는 언제나처럼: Please keep looking after Linford, as you always have. Hailey, continue striking down the demons that threaten the world...
strings.아리엘은 린포드를 지키는 수호 천사로서 아마란스 노바 앞에서 위험한 일이: And Ariel, as Linford's guardian angel, watch over the entrance to Amaranth Nova and keep anything dangerous from happening.
Why do you look so surprised? You've had plenty of rest.
Live as you normally would, and watch over their souls so they do not crumble.
strings.(이리스가 환하게 웃으며 아리엘의 날개를 쓰다듬는다.): (Iris smiles brightly and strokes Ariel's wings.)
Then someday, you'll be able to regain your original wings.
My wings, just as they were...
strings.그런데 %s 님, 누군가와 함께 오지 않으셨나요?: But %s, didn't you come with someone?
I came with Elliot, one of Linford's residents.
strings.그런데 이리스, 신탁의 방을 계속 비워도 되는 거야?: By the way, Iris, is it all right to stay away from the Oracle Chamber this long?
I haven't left it... How should I explain this...?
I can now separate and control my divine and human aspects to some extent.
strings.신탁의 방에서 '신'으로서 위대한 벽을 살펴보는 동안, '이리스'로서 움: While I watch over the Great Wall as a 'god' in the Oracle Chamber, I can move around as 'Iris.'
Though I can't keep it up for very long...
Wow, that's amazing! No one's ever been like you, Lady Iris...
strings.가이아 님처럼 현신을 만드시거나 아그니 님처럼 인간으로 변해 살아간 경우: Some created incarnations like Lady Gaia, or became human and lived among them like Lord Agni.
...I didn't expect to be praised for this...
strings.(이제 자유롭게 움직일 수 있게 됐다는 건가…. 그렇다면 그만큼 책임도: (So she can move freely now... That means her responsibilities will grow too...)
strings.%s, 미안해요. 지금 이 상태가 익숙하지 않아서 돌아가서 쉬어야 할 것: %s, I'm sorry. I'm not used to being like this yet, so I think I need to return and rest.
We need to find Daphne between the Great Walls soon... I'll call you shortly.
strings.(이리스가 두 손을 모으자 그 앞으로 빛의 원이 생성된다.): (Iris brings her hands together, and a circle of light forms before her.)
strings.(이리스가 모두의 인사를 받고 신탁의 방이 보이는 원 안으로 발걸음을 옮: (After receiving everyone's farewells, Iris steps into the circle, through which the Oracle Chamber is visible.)
strings.(빛의 원과 함께 이리스의 모습이 사라지자 긴장이 풀린 아리엘이 그 자리: (When Iris vanishes with the circle of light, Ariel relaxes and sinks to the ground.)
strings.저는 이제 마을로 가 볼게요. 두 분은 어떻게 하실 거예요?: I'll head into the village now. What will you two do?
To meet the actual God of the Astral Realm in person...
Oh, there's work to do, so I think I should talk to Ariel.
We have to, Ariel. It's Lady Iris's command...
strings.흐음, 과거를 용서받았지만… 앞으로 계속 일을 하게 될 줄이야…. (중얼: Hmm. My past is forgiven, but now I have to keep working... (Mutter, mutter.)
Ha ha. See you later, then.
strings.%s 님 걸음이 빠르군요. 말이 끝나기가 무섭게 사라지시네. 그런데 헤일: %s walks so fast. Gone before we'd even finished speaking. But Hailey, what's behind you...?
What is it now? Aaaaaagh!! A giant Priring!
Ariel, it's good to see you. It's been a long time. Ring. Juriring is here. Ring.
strings.10년 만인가? 아니, 100년 만인가? 그런데 무슨 일이야?: Has it been ten years? No, a hundred? What brings you here?
I'm here to cheer you on. Ring.
strings.(주택가로 들어서서 주위를 살펴보는 %s의 옷깃을 누군가가 조심스레 잡아: (As %s enters the residential district and looks around, someone gently tugs at their clothes.)
I'm fine. At some point, the bad things disappeared...
And I don't think I can see strange things anymore...
strings.어떻게 된 건지는 묻지 않을게요. 그냥 저기서 열심히 싸워 준 사제님들: I won't ask what happened. I'll just believe it's thanks to the priests who fought so hard over there.
strings.(샤를로테가 %s에게 인사하고 집으로 돌아가는 모습을 봤는지, 멀리서 엘: (Perhaps having seen Charlotte say goodbye to %s and head home, Elliot runs over from a distance, on the verge of tears.)
strings.기억이 와, 완벽하게 도, 돌아온 것 같아요!! 키릴 형도 멀쩡해요!!: I-I think his memories have c-completely returned!! Kiril is fine too!! So is everyone else!!
That's wonderful. Elliot, you can stop crying.
strings.그러면 린포드에서 %s 님이 하실 일은 이제 끝났나요?: Does that mean your work in Linford is finished, %s?
Yes. That's why I'm looking around the village now.
strings.여전히 제게는 린포드를 떠난 게 3년 전 일처럼 느껴지지만, 이제는 신경: It still feels like I left Linford three years ago, but I'm going to stop worrying about it... Whether it's been three years or ten, I'm happy to be home...
strings.다음에 기회가 되면 도로시 마을에 가서 글린다 님과 비나, 루노 아저씨에: If I get the chance, I'd like to visit Dorothy Village and thank Glinda, Binah, and Mr. Runo.
If I happen to stop by Dorothy Village, I'll pass on your regards.
strings.아, 또… 누가 있던 것 같은데…. 누구지? 요리조리 정령하고 먼치킨 일: Oh, there was... someone else, I think... Who was it? Not the Elusive Boss or the Munchkin tribe...
strings.곧 떠나실 생각은 아니죠?: You're not planning to leave right away, are you?
strings.아버지가 마을을 위해 애쓰신 사제님들에게 보답을 하고 싶어 하세요. 그러: My father wants to repay the priests who worked so hard for the village. So... please come to our house...
...It's all right if you don't, but I'd be a little disappointed...
I'll go buy a few things at Kiril's shop. See you later.
I think I've seen all of Linford... There doesn't seem to be any danger left...
Then shall I head to Benjamin's house...?
strings.다시 한번 마을 사람들을 대표해서 인사드립니다. 마을을 지켜 주셔서 진심: Once again, on behalf of the villagers, thank you. We are truly grateful that you protected our home.
Please, we only did what we had to.
Thank you for this magnificent hospitality. All thanks belong to the goddess.
strings.벤자민 씨, 둘이 먹다 둘이 죽어도 모를 정도로 맛있어요. 그럼 린포드에: Benjamin, this is so delicious I could die eating it and never notice. I'm looking forward to our stay in Linford.
Father Askren, we're leaving early tomorrow morning.
strings.네? 천사의 도시 린포드에 왔잖아요. 볼 게 얼마나 많은데, 벌써 간다고: What? We're in Linford, the City of Angels! There's so much to see, and we're leaving already?
...I'll stay here. You two go ahead.
It's something only you can do, Father Askren. It will please the goddess, too.
If it's for the goddess, then I must step forward.
He's an easy elf to handle. I thought they were all serious like Hailey...
strings.이런 게 진짜 예전 린포드지요. 이제 다시 그 시절처럼 자유롭게 오갈 수: This is what Linford used to be like. To think we can come and go freely again, just as we did then... I'm so excited.
strings.저는 아들놈과 나눌 이야기가 많아 먼저 물러나겠습니다. 모두 시간 내주셔: My son and I have much to discuss, so I'll take my leave. Thank you all for your time.
I have to tidy up the shop, so I'll be going too. Goodbye, everyone.
I'll head in and rest too. Get some rest, everyone. Thank you for your hard work.
strings.아무것도 아니야. 그보다 함께 가 줬으면 해. 다프네가 갈 만한 곳이 있: It's nothing. More importantly, I'd like you to come with us. There's somewhere Daphne might go.
strings.지금의 이리스 님이라면 누가 어디 있는지 어느 정도 아실 수 있을 텐데,: Lady Iris should now be able to sense roughly where people are. If there's a place even she can't find...
strings.(아스크렌이 물고 있던 빵을 떨어뜨리며 리디아를 빤히 바라본다.): (Askren drops the bread from his mouth and stares at Lydia.)
strings.설마, 우리 마계로 가나요?: Are we going to the Demon Realm?
